Assumption_Register.title: Lean direct hierarchy
Assumption_Register.statement: Lucie MVP requires one root agency and direct downlines only.

Assumption_Register.title: M00 v1.1 remains controlled
Assumption_Register.statement: M00 changes enter only through proposed deltas and activation gates.

Assumption_Register.title: M01 is protected
Assumption_Register.statement: Release 1 history and identifiers remain immutable; proposed deltas are append-only.

Assumption_Register.title: Single tenant marketplace
Assumption_Register.statement: M04 provides one active marketplace for the Lucie tenant.

Assumption_Register.title: M06 follows M05
Assumption_Register.statement: Agency and workforce operational profile implementation consumes M05 identity.

Assumption_Register.title: M08 owns sellability
Assumption_Register.statement: M05 does not independently authorize regulated selling.

Assumption_Register.title: M00 provides shared work
Assumption_Register.statement: M05 consumes tasks, exceptions, notifications, imports and exports.

Assumption_Register.title: United States only
Assumption_Register.statement: M00 geography supports the launch address scope.

Assumption_Register.title: Bilingual release
Assumption_Register.statement: English and Spanish are required for activated user-facing behavior.

Assumption_Register.title: AMS is reference only
Assumption_Register.statement: The external workbook informs completeness but cannot establish scope.

Assumption_Register.title: Activation inputs arrive later
Assumption_Register.statement: Pilot tenant, real data, credentials and formal approvals are launch inputs rather than packet blockers.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 001
Business_Rule_Register.statement: An Organization belongs to exactly one Tenant and tenant_id is immutable in ordinary operation.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 002
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A customer Tenant has exactly one effective owning Organization.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 003
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A customer Tenant has exactly one active root AGENCY.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 004
Business_Rule_Register.statement: The root AGENCY has no active parent relationship.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 005
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every operational downline AGENCY has exactly one active PARENT_OF relationship from the root.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 006
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A downline cannot be an active parent in the Lucie MVP.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 007
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Parent and child in an OrganizationRelationship are AGENCY organizations in the same tenant.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 008
Business_Rule_Register.statement: No relationship links an organization to itself or creates a cycle.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 009
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Relationship effective periods for a child cannot overlap.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 010
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A downline cannot activate without an accepted active downline Agency Administrator membership.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 011
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Relationship-derived authority is granted only to an active AGENCY_ADMIN assigned to the active root.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 012
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Ordinary agents and staff do not inherit root-wide administrative visibility.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 013
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A downline user cannot access root-private records or a sibling downline.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 014
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Root access never crosses the tenant boundary.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 015
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Explicit downline context never changes the actual authenticated user.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 016
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A persistent context banner is required for every downline administration screen.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 017
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Administrative visibility never grants regulated selling authority.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 018
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Completed evidence and immutable history cannot be edited in place.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 019
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Root visibility does not change originating or responsible organization attribution.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 020
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every material canonical mutation writes history, audit and outbox event atomically.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 021
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every event consumer is idempotent.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 022
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every tenant-scoped database table uses forced row-level security.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 023
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Sensitive identifiers are masked by default and plaintext is excluded from logs and events.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 024
Business_Rule_Register.statement: An all-or-nothing import commits no row when any blocking error exists.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 025
Business_Rule_Register.statement: An organization has one active headquarters and one active mailing address.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 026
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Carrier and shared vendor canonical references are JET-controlled.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 027
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A downline receives no independent marketplace or provider route in Lucie MVP.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 028
Business_Rule_Register.statement: No proposed M00 or M01 delta is implemented before governed approval.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 029
Business_Rule_Register.statement: AMS source concepts cannot create scope without a Lucie stable ID and disposition.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 030
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Production activation is separate from deployment and requires every applicable launch gate.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 031
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Root administrators may create direct downlines without routine JET approval only when all fixed validation and no-block conditions pass.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 032
Business_Rule_Register.statement: JET may override root or downline state but must provide reason, evidence and notification treatment.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 033
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Root administrators have full administrative visibility into direct-downline records, but ordinary root agents and staff do not.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 034
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every downline context action is attributed to the actual root administrator and relationship used.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 035
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A root administrator cannot perform a regulated action unless separate affiliation and sellability controls pass.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 036
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Reference EMPLOYER and PARTNER records may be created by root administrators but grant no access or workflow.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 037
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Carrier and shared VENDOR identities remain JET-controlled.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 038
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Legal identity changes apply prospectively through versions and never rewrite prior transaction evidence.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 039
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Changing a root default does not silently update existing downlines.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 040
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Bulk lifecycle action may suspend or reactivate but cannot bulk-end downlines.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 041
Business_Rule_Register.statement: An ended organization is retained and cannot be routinely reactivated.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 042
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A future-dated relationship remains Pending and grants no current scope.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 043
Business_Rule_Register.statement: M05 readiness is a derived outcome and not a user-entered pass or fail field.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 044
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A failed downstream propagation remains visible as pending or failed until reconciled.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 045
Business_Rule_Register.statement: M05 does not create a marketplace, user credential, license, appointment, document file or CRM person.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 046
Business_Rule_Register.statement: All user-facing content and notification baselines are available in English and Spanish.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 047
Business_Rule_Register.statement: The same global user may administer different organizations only through M00 memberships and explicit M05 context.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 048
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Exports contain only screen-authorized fields and current masking.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 049
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Search authorization is applied before result retrieval and count calculation.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 050
Business_Rule_Register.statement: An import-generated administrator remains an invitation until M00 verification and acceptance.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 051
Business_Rule_Register.statement: One organization may have several offices, but offices are not security boundaries.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 052
Business_Rule_Register.statement: The root may access ended downline history only where retention and authority permit.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 053
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A downline relationship end does not automatically transfer consumers or transactions.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 054
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A root suspension removes parent-derived scope immediately.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 055
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A downline suspension does not permit the root to transact as that downline.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 056
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A document reference never bypasses M13 access controls.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 057
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A proposed prior-module delta is a proposal, not the current approved baseline.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 058
Business_Rule_Register.statement: M05 preserves historical M01 Plan-O and Plan-AI references while using PlanAI where approved by existing delta governance.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 059
Business_Rule_Register.statement: M06 forward references are candidates and cannot be implemented as M06 scope without discovery.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 060
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Phase 1 and North Star context cannot expand Lucie scope by implication.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 061
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every privileged operation includes correlation and causation evidence.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 062
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every release includes a complete source disposition and supersession statement.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 063
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Production seed records are explicitly approved; synthetic data remains nonproduction.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 064
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A release-blocking Critical or High defect prevents activation of affected scope.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 065
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Operational runbooks are executable without undocumented engineering knowledge.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 066
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A status banner or message never exposes stack traces, secrets or raw provider payloads.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 067
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Relationship version used in an authorization decision is retained in audit evidence.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 068
Business_Rule_Register.statement: M00 remains the authorization enforcement owner even when M05 supplies scope.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 069
Business_Rule_Register.statement: M05 owns canonical identity even where downstream modules cache summaries.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 070
Business_Rule_Register.statement: All corrections preserve original values and create new version and evidence.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 071
Business_Rule_Register.statement: An unresolved possible duplicate blocks activation but not necessarily draft completion.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 072
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Provider and marketplace readiness may block organization activation where a downstream pathway requires them.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 073
Business_Rule_Register.statement: An organization reference code is unique within a tenant and never reused.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 074
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A tenant reference code is immutable and globally unique within the platform.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M05 business rule 075
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A user-safe reason accompanies blocked activation or unavailable organization status.

Capability_Register.name: Audit, History and Overrides
Capability_Register.description: Preserve immutable actor, context and before-and-after evidence.

Capability_Register.name: Reference Source and M06 Forward Governance

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Canonical ownership
Decision_Register.decision: M05 is the only canonical owner of Tenant, Organization, Tenant ownership, Organization-to-Tenant assignment, effective-dated OrganizationRelationship, hierarchy history and organization provenance. M00 enforces authorization; M04 owns MarketplaceContext; M06 owns agency and workforce operational profiles; M08 owns licenses, appointments and sellability; M09 owns people and CRM; M13 owns document storage. Downstream modules must reference M05 identifiers rather than create competing organization identities.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Tenant operating model
Decision_Register.decision: Lucie supports one JET internal tenant and one customer tenant per onboarded agency group or approved commercial customer. Multiple organizations, including one tenant-owning root agency and direct downlines, may exist inside a tenant. Each organization belongs to exactly one tenant. Nested tenants, cross-tenant agency hierarchies, a tenant per downline and ordinary cross-tenant user movement are excluded.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Initial tenant provisioning
Decision_Register.decision: A JET Platform Administrator creates a customer tenant and its owning organization through one guided provisioning operation. The flow creates draft records, history and M00 context references, and starts a readiness checklist. It does not create a marketplace or activate production activity.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Tenant record
Decision_Register.decision: Tenant records contain immutable tenant ID and reference code, display name, owning organization, lifecycle, effective dates, boundary classification, M00 commercial and privacy references, optional M04 default marketplace reference, version, provenance and JET-only notes. Pricing, invoices, provider credentials, marketplace branding, product rules and role definitions are excluded.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Tenant lifecycle
Decision_Register.decision: Tenant lifecycle is fixed to DRAFT, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED and ENDED. Draft supports setup only; Active remains subject to M00 activation and launch controls; Suspended blocks normal new activity while preserving records and JET operations; Ended represents controlled offboarding and cannot be routinely reactivated.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Organization lifecycle
Decision_Register.decision: Organization lifecycle is fixed to DRAFT, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED and ENDED. Workflow statuses such as invitation or review do not become canonical lifecycle states. No organization is physically deleted through the application.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Organization types
Decision_Register.decision: Organization types are fixed to JET_PLATFORM, AGENCY, EMPLOYER, CARRIER, VENDOR and PARTNER. Root, parent and downline agencies all remain AGENCY; hierarchy is expressed through relationships. Custom types, MASTER_AGENCY and DOWNLINE_AGENCY types are excluded.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Organization record scope
Decision_Register.decision: M05 owns a lean organization identity: immutable ID, tenant-scoped reference code, type, legal and display names, optional DBA, lifecycle, contact channels, website, addresses, time zone, default language, approved external identifiers, effective dates, version and provenance. Agency roster, affiliations, licenses, appointments, branding, employer quoting, CRM and enrollment data remain downstream.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Organization identity versus domain profiles
Decision_Register.decision: Every domain-specific organization profile references exactly one M05 organization_id. Ending a downstream profile does not delete or automatically end the M05 Organization because historical and cross-domain references must remain intact.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: External organization identifiers
Decision_Register.decision: M05 may retain verified external organization identifiers such as EIN, agency NPN, NAIC carrier code and controlled customer or vendor references. They are masked or encrypted when sensitive, never serve as canonical keys, retain source and verification history, and do not determine licensing or sellability.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Cross-tenant representation of the same legal entity
Decision_Register.decision: The same legal entity appearing in different customer tenants is represented by separate tenant-scoped organizations. A restricted registry match may indicate likely common legal identity but cannot merge tenant data, users, documents, transactions or authority.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Duplicate detection
Decision_Register.decision: Organization creation performs possible-duplicate detection using names, reference codes, identifiers, domains, addresses, telephone and type. A possible match creates a warning and review task; Lucie never automatically merges organization records.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Organization creation authority
Decision_Register.decision: Authorized root Agency Administrators may create, configure, activate, suspend, reactivate and end direct downline agencies inside their tenant. JET approval is not required for routine downline creation, but tenant scope, hierarchy, duplicate, profile, administrator, readiness and JET-block validations are mandatory. JET retains override and emergency authority.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Legal versus operating changes
Decision_Register.decision: Downline and root administrators may update low-risk operating fields. Legal identity, tax and verified identifiers, tenant assignment, ownership, parent relationship and lifecycle changes require governed operations, reasons, effective dates, version history and downstream impact treatment. Historical evidence is never rewritten.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Tenant and organization status interaction
Decision_Register.decision: Tenant and organization statuses remain separate. Tenant suspension makes all contained organizations operationally unavailable without rewriting each status. Suspending one organization does not automatically suspend siblings or children. Ending a root is blocked until direct-downline continuity is addressed.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Tenant ownership change
Decision_Register.decision: Every tenant has exactly one owning organization at an effective time. Ownership change is JET-controlled and requires commercial, security, marketplace, membership, provider, open-work, downstream and prior-module impact review. It does not silently move records or users.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Organization movement between tenants
Decision_Register.decision: An organization tenant_id is immutable in normal operation. A downline becoming an independent customer requires a new tenant, new or migrated organization representation, explicit user and data migration, preserved history and no temporary cross-tenant access.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Mergers, replacements and accidental records
Decision_Register.decision: Lucie does not provide a general organization merge engine. Rename versions the same organization; a new legal entity creates a successor organization; accidental drafts are ended with reason; identifiers are never reused; historical transactions retain the organization/version used at the time.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Address and location posture
Decision_Register.decision: M05 supports one headquarters address, one mailing address defaulting to headquarters, optional office locations, fixed location types, United States geography through M00 reference data and effective-dated history. International address support, map territories, branch contracts and location-based permission hierarchies are excluded.

Decision_Register.topic: Tenant and Organization Establishment and Lifecycle
Decision_Register.title: Prior-module continuity
Decision_Register.decision: Every M05 decision is evaluated against M00 and protected M01. The packet includes upstream contract consumption, prior-delivered-module impact registers, proposed append-only deltas, compatibility, migration, rollback, release notes and cumulative regression for CTX-003 Tenant, CTX-004 Organization and CTX-005 OrganizationRelationship.

Decision_Register.title: Relationship purpose
Decision_Register.decision: Lucie stores one directed PARENT_OF relationship whose inverse is displayed as DOWNLINE_OF. It establishes operating hierarchy, administration scope, assignment context, reporting and history only; it does not establish legal ownership, contract sharing, commissions, revenue sharing, licensing or product authority.

Decision_Register.title: Eligible organizations
Decision_Register.decision: PARENT_OF may connect only two AGENCY organizations in the same tenant. JET_PLATFORM, EMPLOYER, CARRIER, VENDOR and PARTNER do not participate in the Lucie agency hierarchy.

Decision_Register.title: Lean hierarchy depth
Decision_Register.decision: Lucie supports one direct-downline level. The tenant-owning agency is the root and all operational downlines are direct children. Downlines cannot create children; regional, branch and arbitrary graph layers are excluded. Stable identifiers and effective dates preserve a future seam.

Decision_Register.title: Root agency rule
Decision_Register.decision: The tenant-owning AGENCY is the single root, has no parent and may have many direct downlines. Every other active AGENCY in that tenant must have one active relationship to the root unless it is explicitly draft, ended or reference-only.

Decision_Register.title: One active parent
Decision_Register.decision: A downline has exactly one active parent. Multiple or overlapping parents, self-relationships, cycles and duplicate active relationships are prohibited through database and service validation.

Decision_Register.title: Relationship lifecycle
Decision_Register.decision: Relationship lifecycle is fixed to PENDING, ACTIVE and ENDED. Future-dated approved relationships remain Pending; Active grants approved hierarchy scope; Ended preserves history and grants no current authority. Temporary restrictions use status or authorization controls rather than a custom relationship state.

Decision_Register.title: Relationship creation authority
Decision_Register.decision: Authorized root Agency Administrators may create and activate direct-downline relationships after fixed validations pass; routine JET approval is not required. JET may block, suspend, correct, end or restore a relationship for security, legal, contractual, support or platform reasons.

Decision_Register.title: Creating and configuring a downline
Decision_Register.decision: The root receives a guided Create Downline Agency flow covering identity, legal identifiers, contacts, addresses, settings, initial administrator, inherited tenant controls, relationship, readiness and activation. Draft save and resume is supported. JET is not responsible for routine execution.

Decision_Register.title: Relationship effective dates
Decision_Register.decision: Every relationship retains effective_from, optional effective_to, activation and end dates and reasons, creator/approver provenance, version and immutable history. Corrections after the relationship governed activity require a separate correction record.

Decision_Register.title: Root agency administration authority
Decision_Register.decision: Authorized root Agency Administrators have complete administration authority over direct downlines: profile, contacts, settings, users, fixed roles, readiness, tasks, records, communications, documents, application and handoff status, activity and reporting. JET retains broader override. Secrets, JET-only notes and regulated authority remain protected.

Decision_Register.title: Downline administrator authority
Decision_Register.decision: A downline Agency Administrator manages its own organization and records but cannot access the root's private records, sibling downlines, create another downline, change or remove its parent, move tenants or override root or JET restrictions.

Decision_Register.title: Downline record visibility
Decision_Register.decision: An active parent relationship grants authorized root Agency Administrators full visibility into the direct downline's business records and settings, subject to masking, module controls, legal restrictions and audit. Ordinary root agents and staff do not inherit that full scope, and administrative visibility does not grant regulated selling authority.

Decision_Register.title: Root agency operational reporting
Decision_Register.decision: The root may see aggregate and record-level operational information for direct downlines. M24 later supplies richer historical analytics, but originating workspaces must honor root administrative visibility without exposing secrets or unrestricted sensitive values.

Decision_Register.title: Organization Structure experience
Decision_Register.decision: Organization Structure is a fixed root-and-direct-children experience with create, open, edit, manage users, view records, readiness, suspend, reactivate, end relationship and history actions. JET sees the same plus platform overrides. Drag-and-drop, arbitrary graphs and multi-level expansion are excluded.

Decision_Register.title: Reassigning a downline
Decision_Register.decision: Downline reassignment is rare and JET-controlled, used only after tenant-owner change or correction. Current and proposed parent, effective date, commercial, security, membership, marketplace, provider and open-work review and non-overlap are mandatory.

Decision_Register.title: Ending a relationship
Decision_Register.decision: Ending a relationship requires a continuity disposition for the downline, users, open work, transactions, external activity and history. Parent-derived access stops at effective end; consumer and transaction assignments are never silently transferred.

Decision_Register.title: Root agency suspension
Decision_Register.decision: Suspending the root immediately removes parent-derived authority but does not rewrite child organization states. A direct downline may continue only if tenant, organization, direct memberships, commercial controls and an approved operational support path permit it.

Decision_Register.title: Downline suspension
Decision_Register.decision: Suspending a downline blocks new normal activity for that organization. The root retains approved status, history and transition visibility but cannot transact as the downline merely because it is the parent.

Decision_Register.title: Marketplace and provider behavior
Decision_Register.decision: The hierarchy does not create separate marketplaces or provider routes. One tenant marketplace and M00 provider configuration remain authoritative; a downline may have attribution and communication identity settings but no independent storefront or provider credentials in Lucie MVP.

Decision_Register.title: Workforce affiliation boundary
Decision_Register.decision: M05 hierarchy does not create workforce affiliation, employment, writing agency, captive status, commission ownership or licensing authority. M06 and M08 remain authoritative; relationship changes require explicit downstream affiliation impact handling.

Decision_Register.title: Commercial and financial boundary
Decision_Register.decision: PARENT_OF is an operational hierarchy only and does not represent legal ownership, contract sharing, selling paper, commissions, payments, sponsorship, book ownership, product access or carrier appointment hierarchy. Those remain downstream seams.

Decision_Register.title: Relationship notifications and audit
Decision_Register.decision: Relationship requests, activations, scheduled starts and ends, corrections and ends notify relevant administrators in their selected language and produce immutable audit events with actor, context, before/after, reason, effective date and correlation ID.

Decision_Register.title: Future compatibility
Decision_Register.decision: The relationship contract preserves stable ID, parent and child IDs, type, status, version, effective dates, provenance and an extensible metadata boundary. Future depth or relationship types require a governed future packet and are not exposed now.

Decision_Register.title: M00 and M01 continuity
Decision_Register.decision: M05 proposes M00 and protected M01 deltas for hierarchy-derived context, authorization, visibility, attribution, assignment, JET EDE context, notifications, audit and regression. Existing baselines remain unchanged until approval.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Organization profile experience
Decision_Register.decision: M05 provides one fixed Organization Profile with Overview, Legal identity, Contacts, Addresses and offices, External identifiers, Organization settings, Relationships, Readiness and Activity/history. Sections vary only by type and authority; custom sections, fields and configurable layouts are excluded.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Root and downline profile authority
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may view and edit the complete profile of every direct downline; downline administrators edit their own permitted data. Root overrides downline values and JET overrides both. Every edit preserves actual actor, context, old and new values, time and required reason.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Downline-owned settings
Decision_Register.decision: Downline-owned settings include display and DBA names, contacts, telephone, email, website, addresses, offices, time zone, language, hours, consumer support information, assignment defaults, communication preferences, readiness and later downstream operational profile settings. Root administrators may edit or override them.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Setting defaults and inheritance
Decision_Register.decision: Root or tenant defaults are copied into a new downline's initial profile. Later changes do not silently propagate. The root may explicitly apply selected approved values to one or more downlines after reviewing current and proposed values and exclusions. Dynamic inheritance and formulas are excluded.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Legal identity changes
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may propose legal name, DBA, tax identifier, agency NPN and other approved identifier changes. Material changes require reason, effective date, evidence, new version, reverification, downstream impact review and audit; JET may reject or correct them.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Organization contact roles
Decision_Register.decision: Contact roles are fixed to PRIMARY_BUSINESS, OPERATIONS, SUPPORT and COMPLIANCE. Each may reference name, title, email, phone, language and optional M00 user. M05 stores contact points, not a competing M09 person record; custom roles are excluded.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Contact visibility
Decision_Register.decision: Root and authorized downline administrators see organization contacts within scope. Ordinary workforce users and consumers see only approved purpose-specific contact information. Internal direct details, notes and compliance contacts are not automatically exposed.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Address model
Decision_Register.decision: Organizations may have one HEADQUARTERS, one MAILING and multiple OFFICE addresses. Mailing defaults to headquarters. Addresses are United States only, validated against M00 geography and effective-dated. International and custom location types are excluded.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Office locations
Decision_Register.decision: An office location contains name, type, address, main telephone, optional support email, time zone, business hours and active status. It does not create a tenant, organization, workspace, contract or permission boundary.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Business hours
Decision_Register.decision: Organizations and offices support one simple weekly business-hours schedule with daily open and close times, closed days and organization time zone. Holiday calendars, split shifts, seasonal schedules, capacity calculations and routing rules are excluded.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Organization language
Decision_Register.decision: Organization default language is English or Spanish, with English default. Individual M00 user preference takes precedence. Language changes apply prospectively and do not rewrite prior documents, communications, consent or audit evidence.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: External identifier types
Decision_Register.decision: Identifier types are fixed to EIN, AGENCY_NPN, NAIC_CARRIER_CODE, JET_CUSTOMER_CODE, VENDOR_REFERENCE, PARTNER_REFERENCE and EXTERNAL_ORGANIZATION_CODE. Records retain masked value, source, verification, dates, version and evidence. Custom types are excluded.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Identifier verification states
Decision_Register.decision: Identifier verification states are UNVERIFIED, PENDING_VERIFICATION, VERIFIED and REJECTED. Root may enter or update; an approved service or JET verifies. Rejected values remain in history and cannot be used as valid downstream evidence.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Organization readiness
Decision_Register.decision: Agency readiness uses a fixed checklist for legal and reference identity, contacts, headquarters, time zone, language, verified identifier, active parent if downline, active administrator, required downstream profile and no blocking exception. Readiness is separate from lifecycle and cannot be manually passed without resolving the control.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Reference employers and partners
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may create tenant-scoped EMPLOYER and PARTNER reference organizations. These records grant no access, workspace, commercial activation, contract or marketplace until a downstream module adds the appropriate profile.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Carrier and vendor references
Decision_Register.decision: Carrier and shared vendor reference organizations remain JET-controlled. Root agencies submit a request when no valid reference exists and may maintain tenant-specific aliases linked to the controlled reference. Competing carrier and vendor identities are prohibited.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Reference organization isolation
Decision_Register.decision: Reference organizations remain tenant-scoped unless explicitly owned as JET platform references. Creating a reference never invites a user, creates a route, contract, product access, selling authority or transaction.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Organization notes
Decision_Register.decision: Organization notes use AGENCY_VISIBLE and JET_ONLY visibility. Notes are append-only, timestamped and attributed; corrections use a new note. Custom visibility matrices are excluded.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Organization documents
Decision_Register.decision: M05 associates organizations to document references and purpose or status only. M13 owns storage, scanning, classification, access, retention, secure links and downloads. M05 never creates a competing attachment store.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Organization search and directory
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators receive a tenant-wide organization directory with type, hierarchy, lifecycle, readiness, contact, location, identifier summary, blockers and last update. Downline administrators see their own agency and permitted references only. JET searches across explicit tenant context.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Profile change history
Decision_Register.decision: Profiles expose immutable history for creation, lifecycle, legal, contact, address, identifier, setting, readiness, relationship and override changes. History identifies actual actor, context, time, old and new values and reason with sensitive-value masking.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: M04 branding and marketplace boundary
Decision_Register.decision: M05 supplies M04 identity, legal, display and DBA names, approved contacts, language, responsible agency, lifecycle and readiness. M04 alone owns logo, theme, marketplace name and domain, visibility, routing, attribution presentation and storefront support. Downlines receive no independent storefront.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Downstream profile contract
Decision_Register.decision: M05 publishes a versioned Organization Summary including tenant and organization IDs, type, names, lifecycle, parent reference, contacts, location, language, identifier summaries, readiness, version and effective dates. Downstream caches remain subordinate to M05 and consume material-change events.

Decision_Register.topic: Organization Profiles, Contacts, Addresses and References
Decision_Register.title: Prior-module continuity
Decision_Register.decision: Profile decisions produce M00 and protected M01 impacts for context display, invitations, addresses, identifiers, agency attribution, support identity, record visibility, audit, bilingual content, marketplace and JET EDE context.

Decision_Register.title: Relationship-derived administrative scope
Decision_Register.decision: An active PARENT_OF relationship grants the root's authorized AGENCY_ADMIN administrative scope over direct downlines in the same tenant. M05 decides valid hierarchy scope; M00 enforces it. Downstream modules consume the shared scope and never independently implement hierarchy authorization.

Decision_Register.title: No separate root-agency role
Decision_Register.decision: Lucie does not create a MASTER_AGENCY_ADMIN role. Root authority results from active AGENCY_ADMIN assignment to the tenant-owning active root, active tenant, active relationship and no JET block. A downline AGENCY_ADMIN receives only its own scope.

Decision_Register.title: Explicit downline context selection
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators explicitly enter a downline operating context from structure, directory, profile, search or reporting. They never impersonate a downline user. Context records actual user, root, selected downline, tenant, marketplace, relationship, role and policy version.

Decision_Register.title: Persistent acting-context banner
Decision_Register.decision: While operating in downline context, a persistent banner identifies the managed downline, root agency, tenant and return action. Every change is attributed to the actual root administrator and relationship, never to a downline user.

Decision_Register.title: Root-agency consolidated view
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators receive consolidated authorized views across the root and direct downlines, including historical suspended or ended records where permitted. Filters are fixed to organization, status, owner, module, date and work type; custom dashboards and arbitrary query builders are excluded.

Decision_Register.title: Full downline record visibility
Decision_Register.decision: Authorized root administrators may view all direct-downline business records across affected Lucie modules, subject to masking, legal hold, security and module restrictions. Credentials, authentication factors, provider secrets, hidden security signals and JET-only notes remain excluded.

Decision_Register.title: Root administrative write authority
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may perform the same approved administrative and operational actions as a downline administrator through the owning module's governed workflow. Direct database-style editing and bypassing module validation are prohibited.

Decision_Register.title: Final and evidentiary record protection
Decision_Register.decision: Signed documents, accepted consent, submitted applications, completed handoffs, confirmed enrollments, final quote evidence, provider responses, audit and legal-hold records are immutable or version-controlled. Corrections use amendment, withdrawal, replacement or correction workflows.

Decision_Register.title: Regulated-action boundary
Decision_Register.decision: Administrative visibility does not grant regulated selling. A root user may act as seller only with active M06 affiliation, M08 ALLOWED sellability, appropriate role and permission, assignment or assistance basis and required consumer authorization.

Decision_Register.title: Ordinary root-agency users
Decision_Register.decision: Ordinary root-agency selling agents and unlicensed staff do not automatically gain tenant-wide downline visibility. They require assignment, affiliation, consumer-approved assistance, takeover or another module-specific access basis.

Decision_Register.title: Downline isolation
Decision_Register.decision: A downline administrator accesses its own profile, settings, workforce, records and permitted shared references. It cannot access root-private data, sibling organizations, sibling users, sibling reports or JET-only controls.

Decision_Register.title: Sibling downline separation
Decision_Register.decision: Sibling downlines are isolated. Peer-to-peer browsing or sharing is prohibited. Eligible record transfer between siblings is initiated or approved by an authorized root administrator through governed reassignment or handoff.

Decision_Register.title: Record organization attribution
Decision_Register.decision: Every downstream business record identifies originating organization, current responsible organization, assignee, tenant, marketplace and assignment history where applicable. Root visibility does not silently change ownership or attribution.

Decision_Register.title: Record reassignment
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may reassign eligible open leads, assistance requests, tasks, draft quotes, draft applications and unresolved work among the root and direct downlines with reason, effective date, communication and audit. Final or externally submitted evidence uses owning-module transfer or correction processes.

Decision_Register.title: Consumer and member disclosure
Decision_Register.decision: Consumer and member experiences identify the currently responsible agency, approved root and downline operating relationship, support contact and assigned agent where applicable. Routine root oversight does not require repeated consent, but changed assignment, purpose, seller or destination does.

Decision_Register.title: Sensitive information and reveal controls
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators receive default masking. Sensitive-value reveal requires explicit permission, business need, approved workflow and audit. Lists, search, exports and reporting remain masked by default.

Decision_Register.title: Organization-wide search
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may search authorized records across the tenant with responsible organization, record type, status, assignee and date. Opening a downline result establishes explicit downline context. Downline search remains restricted.

Decision_Register.title: Downline-specific communications identity
Decision_Register.decision: Downlines may define approved communication identity such as display name, reply-to, support phone, signature block and verified sender profile while using the single M00-controlled tenant provider route. Root may configure and override identity; M10 owns templates and delivery.

Decision_Register.title: Marketplace attribution
Decision_Register.decision: M04 may display M05 responsible agency, agent, contact, downline attribution and disclosure inside the one tenant marketplace. M05 does not create a separate downline storefront, domain, catalogue or provider route.

Decision_Register.title: Documents and secure links
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may view downline documents only when the related record is in authorized scope and M13 document controls allow access. Relationship scope never bypasses classification, masking, retention, secure-link or download controls.

Decision_Register.title: Exports and bulk actions
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may export approved data across selected direct downlines with scope, purpose, date range, masking and audit. Bulk actions are limited to safe settings, work assignment, reminders and invitation suspension; transaction history cannot be bulk rewritten.

Decision_Register.title: Relationship change and access revocation
Decision_Register.decision: Relationship end or invalidation revokes new parent-derived access immediately, refreshes active scope, blocks open-screen actions, requires background-job reauthorization and preserves permitted history. Reactivation restores scope only after current policy checks pass.

Decision_Register.title: Organization status impact
Decision_Register.decision: Downline suspension blocks its users and new normal transactions while allowing root and JET investigation and resolution. Root suspension stops parent-derived scope. Tenant suspension blocks all normal hierarchy activity.

Decision_Register.title: Shared downstream access contract
Decision_Register.decision: M05 publishes a versioned Effective Administrative Scope contract containing tenant owner, direct-downline relationships, user root-admin status, effective organizations, selected operating context, relationship version, effective date and policy version. M00 remains enforcement owner.

Decision_Register.title: Downstream ownership boundaries
Decision_Register.decision: M05 hierarchy and visibility do not replace downstream ownership: M04 marketplace, M06 profiles and affiliations, M08 licenses and sellability, M09 people and CRM, M10 communications, M13 documents, M20 employer flows, M24 analytics and M26 applications remain authoritative.

Decision_Register.title: M00 impact and proposed deltas
Decision_Register.decision: M05 proposes controlled M00 deltas for root scope, context selection and banner, full downline administration, search, sibling isolation, session refresh, attribution, exports, overrides, audit, permissions and regression. M00 v1.1 remains unchanged until approval.

Decision_Register.title: Protected M01 impact and deltas
Decision_Register.decision: M05 extends protected M01 deltas for downline consumers, quotes, PlanAI, applications, handoffs, agency disclosure, masking, audit, reassignment, relationship termination and bilingual regression. M05 leads M1D-005 without silently changing Release 1.

Decision_Register.title: Fixed organization administration surfaces
Decision_Register.decision: M05 provides fixed Organization Administration Home, Directory, Structure, Profile, Create Downline, Readiness, Imports, Tasks and Exceptions, Change History and JET Operations surfaces. Available actions depend on JET, root Agency Administrator or downline Agency Administrator. Custom pages, fields and saved views are excluded.

Decision_Register.title: Root Agency Administration Home
Decision_Register.decision: Root Administration Home shows root status, downline lifecycle counts, activation blockers, invitations, identifier issues, open tasks and exceptions, recent changes and quick actions. It is an operational summary, not a configurable M24 analytics dashboard.

Decision_Register.title: Downline Administration Home
Decision_Register.decision: Downline Administration Home shows its own completeness, lifecycle, parent, administrators, workforce summary, readiness, issues, next actions, recent changes and root or JET overrides. Sibling browsing is prohibited.

Decision_Register.title: Guided downline creation
Decision_Register.decision: Create Downline is a fixed guided sequence for identity, legal identifiers, contacts, addresses and offices, settings, initial administrator, readiness and activation. Draft save and resume is supported and the root is automatically selected as parent. Configurable onboarding is excluded.

Decision_Register.title: Downline activation
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may activate a downline when the fixed profile, duplicate, address, contact, language and time-zone, identifier, relationship, active administrator, downstream profile, exception and tenant checks pass and no JET block exists. JET routine approval is not required.

Decision_Register.title: Initial administrator requirement
Decision_Register.decision: A downline cannot activate until at least one invited downline Agency Administrator has accepted and holds active M00 membership. Loss of the last active administrator creates an urgent readiness exception rather than silently ending the organization.

Decision_Register.title: Manual CSV import
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may create direct downlines through the shared M00 all-or-nothing CSV import using one fixed M05 template. JET may do so in explicit tenant context. Downline users cannot import agencies. Custom columns, mapping, formulas, nesting and cross-tenant import are excluded.

Decision_Register.title: Importable organization information
Decision_Register.decision: The fixed import template supports approved organization identity, contacts, addresses, time zone, language, external identifiers, initial administrator and initial settings. It may create invitations but never credentials or authenticated users. Carrier and shared vendor creation is excluded.

Decision_Register.title: Import validation and commit
Decision_Register.decision: Imports validate all rows for required fields, uniqueness, duplicates, type, geography, contact format, identifiers, administrator, hierarchy, tenant scope, lifecycle and readiness. Any blocking row prevents all commits and produces a row-level error report.

Decision_Register.title: Imported activation behavior
Decision_Register.decision: Imports create DRAFT organizations by default. Requested activation proceeds only if every activation requirement, including accepted administrator invitation and verification, is already satisfied. Successful file validation alone never proves production readiness.

Decision_Register.title: Applying root defaults to downlines
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may apply selected approved defaults to chosen downlines after reviewing current and proposed values, exclusions and impact. Dynamic inheritance, formulas and automatic synchronization are excluded.

Decision_Register.title: Bulk lifecycle actions
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators may bulk suspend or reactivate selected direct downlines with reason, explanation, effective date, user and open-work review, confirmation and audit. Ending is individual. JET uses M00 tenant emergency suspension for tenant-wide incidents.

Decision_Register.title: Reference-organization operations
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators directly create tenant-scoped employer and partner references. Carrier and shared vendor requests use a fixed request process for JET linking, creation or rejection to prevent duplicates.

Decision_Register.title: Organization task and exception types
Decision_Register.decision: M05 uses fixed task and exception types for duplicates, profile gaps, missing administrator, invalid address, identifier status, relationship conflict, activation block, suspension and ending review, migration, open-work block, downstream profile unavailable, propagation failure and prior-module compatibility.

Decision_Register.title: Exception ownership
Decision_Register.decision: The root owns routine downline profile, administrator, readiness, duplicate, suspension, open-work and setting exceptions. JET owns cross-tenant, tenant ownership, platform reference, security and privacy, commercial, provider, corruption and emergency exceptions. The downline owns its own routine issues until root takes control.

Decision_Register.title: Escalation to the root agency
Decision_Register.decision: A downline may escalate an organization issue to the root using fixed issue type, description, section, requested action, evidence, urgency and blocking impact. Root may resolve, return or escalate to JET. Configurable escalation is excluded.

Decision_Register.title: Legal identity corrections
Decision_Register.decision: Downline administrators request legal identity corrections; root reviews and applies with current and proposed value, effective date, reason, evidence and impact acknowledgement. JET may reject, correct or override. Historical evidence remains tied to the prior version.

Decision_Register.title: Root and JET overrides
Decision_Register.decision: Every root or JET override records actual actor, authority, target, before and after, reason, explanation, effective date, evidence and notification unless restricted. JET overrides root and downline; root overrides downline; neither may override immutable evidence or regulated authority.

Decision_Register.title: Organization notifications
Decision_Register.decision: M05 emits bilingual notifications for creation, invitations, activation, suspension and reactivation, ending, relationship end, readiness block, identifier rejection, legal identity change, root and JET override, migration and import outcomes. M10 owns final templates; M00 baseline notifications bridge until M10.

Decision_Register.title: Activity and change review
Decision_Register.decision: Authorized users review read-only activity history filtered by organization, actor, action, date, section, lifecycle, relationship, override, import and exception. Root sees direct downlines, downline sees itself, and JET uses explicit tenant context. Sensitive values remain masked.

Decision_Register.title: Organization exports
Decision_Register.decision: Root administrators export approved directory, contacts, addresses, identifier summaries, relationship history, readiness, administrator coverage, tasks, exceptions and history as CSV under M00 scope, purpose, masking and audit controls. Downlines export only their own organization.

Decision_Register.title: Readiness recalculation and stale information
Decision_Register.decision: Readiness recalculates whenever profile, administrator, identifier, relationship, status or downstream dependency changes and may be refreshed on demand. Results show ready or blocked, blockers, warnings, evaluation time, owner and next action. Users cannot manually pass failed controls.

Decision_Register.title: Status and change propagation
Decision_Register.decision: Material organization and relationship changes propagate through governed events to M00 and downstream modules. UI distinguishes completed, processing, downstream pending, failed and reconciliation required. Propagation failure creates an operational exception and cannot be presented as success.

Decision_Register.title: Downline suspension, reactivation and offboarding
Decision_Register.decision: Suspension reviews users, leads and tasks, draft work, external transactions, communications and provider activity; reactivation requires resolved blockers and readiness; ending requires an individual offboarding checklist covering work, users, consumers, transactions, documents, handoffs, exports, retention and relationship. Ended organizations are not routinely reactivated.

Decision_Register.title: Support and operational access
Decision_Register.decision: Routine downline administration belongs to the root, not JET. JET provides platform, tenant-owner, cross-tenant duplicate, controlled reference, security and privacy, data correction, emergency suspension and final override support under explicit context, actual identity and audit. Impersonation is prohibited.

Decision_Register.title: M00 and protected M01 continuity
Decision_Register.decision: Operations decisions produce detailed M00 and protected M01 impact and delta records for creation, hierarchy permissions, lifecycle, context, imports, readiness, notifications, overrides, exports, agency attribution, JET EDE and cumulative regression.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Final M05 delivery scope
Decision_Register.decision: M05 delivers production-ready canonical tenant, organization and direct-downline relationship foundations, profiles, readiness, directory and structure, explicit operating contexts, hierarchy-aware scope, imports, tasks, propagation, downstream contracts and M00 and M01 delta packages. It does not implement complete marketplace, agency and agent, licensing, document, product, communications, CRM, enrollment, commission, payment or analytics domains.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: AMS workbook authority
Decision_Register.decision: AMS_Agency_and_Agent_Mgmt.xlsx is REFERENCE_ONLY_NON_BASELINE. It may inform field completeness, navigation, scenarios and forward references but cannot override Lucie decisions, M00, protected M01, ownership or scope, and cannot become a requirement without a new Lucie stable ID.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Reference-source disposition register
Decision_Register.decision: The packet includes a reference-source disposition register with source worksheet and area, concept, Lucie interpretation, target module, disposition, reason, related requirement, forward reference and supersession note. Allowed dispositions are ADOPTED_IN_M05, DEFERRED_TO_M06, DEFERRED_TO_OTHER_MODULE, FUTURE_SEAM_ONLY, EXCLUDED_FROM_LUCIE_MVP and DUPLICATE_OF_APPROVED_REQUIREMENT.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: M06 forward-reference package
Decision_Register.decision: M05 produces an M06 forward-reference package for agency operational profile, roster, agent and staff profile, affiliations, office assignment, administration designation, contacts, communication preferences, status, search, documents, history, notes, interactions and tasks. These are discovery candidates, not approved M06 scope.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Production contract freeze
Decision_Register.decision: M05 freezes production contracts for CTX-003 Tenant, CTX-004 Organization, CTX-005 OrganizationRelationship, Organization Summary, Readiness Summary, Effective Administrative Scope, Context Selection, Status Decision, Attribution and material change events before downstream modules implement assumptions.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: M00 upstream-contract consumption
Decision_Register.decision: M05 consumes M00 identity, session and context, roles and permissions, authentication, activation, feature controls, audit, tasks, notifications, imports and exports, integration operations, privacy and masking, language, environments and release controls without duplication.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Proposed M00 delta set
Decision_Register.decision: The packet proposes M00 deltas for root authority, relationship scope, downline creation and lifecycle, explicit context and banner, full downline visibility, sibling isolation, search, exports, session refresh and revocation, attribution, overrides, permissions, audit and regression.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: M00 delta implementation posture
Decision_Register.decision: M05 may implement its canonical contracts independently, but M00-dependent behavior is versioned, compatibility-adapted, disabled by default and not activated until the proposed M00 delta is approved and implemented.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Protected M01 delta set
Decision_Register.decision: The packet extends protected M01 deltas for canonical organization IDs, downline records, quotes, assistance, attribution, reassignment, PlanAI, applications and EDE, disclosure, masking, audit, lifecycle and bilingual regression. M05 leads M1D-005.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Protected M01 activation rule
Decision_Register.decision: Athina must not implement or activate an M01 proposal while status is DRAFT_FOR_GOVERNED_APPROVAL and implementation status is NOT_STARTED. Approval preserves original IDs, history, terminology, production behavior, migration, compatibility and rollback.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: M04 marketplace handoff
Decision_Register.decision: M05 hands M04 tenant and organization IDs, tenant owner, root and downlines, names, contacts, language, status, readiness and attribution references. M04 exclusively owns MarketplaceContext, storefront, brand assets, domains, visibility, routing and presentation.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: M06 agency and agent handoff
Decision_Register.decision: M06 consumes M05 organization identity and hierarchy and owns agency operational profile, roster, agent and staff business profiles, affiliations, primary agency, office assignment, operational status and onboarding. M05 supplies stable IDs, scope, addresses, contacts, identifiers and lifecycle.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: M08 licensing handoff
Decision_Register.decision: M08 owns licenses, appointments, credentials, NPN usage, FFM IDs, E&O, carrier authorization, captive restrictions, sellability and any approved NPN override. M05 may retain verified agency NPN as an identifier but does not authorize selling.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: M13 document handoff
Decision_Register.decision: M13 owns file storage, scanning, classification, access, secure links, retention, versioning and downloads. M05 stores only organization-document purpose and reference. AMS document-publishing concepts are deferred to M13 discovery.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Initial seed and test organization structure
Decision_Register.decision: Nonproduction seed data includes JET tenant and organization, one synthetic customer tenant and root, three direct downlines, draft and suspended downlines, employer, partner, controlled carrier and vendor references, representative roles, English and Spanish users and duplicate, readiness, import and suspension scenarios. Production uses only approved records.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Data migration posture
Decision_Register.decision: M05 does not include a general legacy migration engine. It supports M00 and M01 identifier compatibility, controlled seed creation, approved CSV import, deterministic M01 organization-reference backfill, unresolved-reference exceptions, versioned evidence and rollback and reconciliation. AMS is not migration data.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: UAT participants
Decision_Register.decision: Formal UAT includes JET administrator, root administrator, downline administrator, root and downline selling agents, unlicensed staff, English and Spanish users, M00 authorization and operations owner and M01 owner for affected journeys. Every permission boundary is independently tested.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Required UAT journeys
Decision_Register.decision: UAT covers manual and CSV creation, save and resume, duplicate review, administrator activation, downline activation, context and banner, profile, defaults and overrides, search and visibility, sibling isolation, ordinary-agent restrictions, reassignment, final-evidence protection, suspension and reactivation, relationship end and access revocation, audit, export, bilingual, accessibility and approved M00 and M01 compatibility.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Security and privacy acceptance
Decision_Register.decision: Security acceptance proves no cross-tenant or sibling access, correct root scope, downline isolation, ordinary-agent restrictions, explicit audited context, immediate revocation, status enforcement, masking and reveal audit, immutable evidence, import tenant confinement, client-context tamper denial, JET override audit and export purpose enforcement.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Production activation gates
Decision_Register.decision: Production activation requires product, architecture, security and privacy, M00 contract, delta disposition, bilingual, accessibility, migration, contract validation, hierarchy security, UAT, runbook rehearsal, monitoring, support, rollback, no Critical or High defect and JET Release Owner go or no-go evidence.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Controlled rollout
Decision_Register.decision: Rollout is JET internal, controlled UAT tenant, one pilot root agency and its approved direct downlines, small cohort, then tenant-by-tenant activation. Hierarchy behavior is not activated globally by deployment.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Operational handover
Decision_Register.decision: Operational handover includes creation, administration, duplicates, identifiers, readiness, imports, lifecycle and offboarding, relationship correction, access troubleshooting, propagation failures, audit, overrides, M00 and M01 continuity, bilingual support, exports, incidents, rollback and reconciliation. Runbooks are executable procedures.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Production-build-ready packet standard
Decision_Register.decision: The packet meets the M00 v1.1 hardened standard: controlled source hierarchy, stable requirements, UX, bilingual and accessibility, canonical models, operation-specific OpenAPI, event-specific AsyncAPI, strict schemas and fixtures, migration-grade DDL, authorization contracts, executable scenarios, security, runbooks, task packs, M00 and M01 deltas, M06 forward references, traceability, manifest, hashes, QA and certification. Starter artifacts are unacceptable.

Decision_Register.topic: Release Acceptance, Source Governance and Prior-Module Delta Closure
Decision_Register.title: Change control and discovery closure
Decision_Register.decision: Approval closes functional discovery. Later changes require a stable change record with original decision, proposed change, reason, M00, M01 and downstream impacts, data, UX, tests, compatibility, approval and target version. The AMS reference cannot expand scope without governed change.

Invariant_Register.statement: An Organization belongs to exactly one Tenant and tenant_id is immutable in ordinary operation.
A customer Tenant has exactly one effective owning Organization.
A customer Tenant has exactly one active root AGENCY.
The root AGENCY has no active parent relationship.
Every operational downline AGENCY has exactly one active PARENT_OF relationship from the root.
A downline cannot be an active parent in the Lucie MVP.
Parent and child in an OrganizationRelationship are AGENCY organizations in the same tenant.
No relationship links an organization to itself or creates a cycle.
Relationship effective periods for a child cannot overlap.
A downline cannot activate without an accepted active downline Agency Administrator membership.
Relationship-derived authority is granted only to an active AGENCY_ADMIN assigned to the active root.
Ordinary agents and staff do not inherit root-wide administrative visibility.
A downline user cannot access root-private records or a sibling downline.
Root access never crosses the tenant boundary.
Explicit downline context never changes the actual authenticated user.
A persistent context banner is required for every downline administration screen.
Administrative visibility never grants regulated selling authority.
Completed evidence and immutable history cannot be edited in place.
Root visibility does not change originating or responsible organization attribution.
Every material canonical mutation writes history, audit and outbox event atomically.
Every event consumer is idempotent.
Every tenant-scoped database table uses forced row-level security.
Sensitive identifiers are masked by default and plaintext is excluded from logs and events.
An all-or-nothing import commits no row when any blocking error exists.
An organization has one active headquarters and one active mailing address.
Carrier and shared vendor canonical references are JET-controlled.
A downline receives no independent marketplace or provider route in Lucie MVP.
No proposed M00 or M01 delta is implemented before governed approval.
AMS source concepts cannot create scope without a Lucie stable ID and disposition.
Production activation is separate from deployment and requires every applicable launch gate.
