Relationship_Register.rule: owning_organization_id references one effective organization inside the tenant.
Every organization belongs to exactly one tenant.
An agency may be root parent of direct downlines.
A downline has no more than one active parent.
Contacts are effective-dated and purpose-specific.
One active headquarters and one active mailing address.
Offices do not create security boundaries.
Identifier-type uniqueness applies within effective period.
One active value per organization and setting key.
Readiness recomputes from fixed controls.
Each fixed control has one current result.
At most one active organization schedule plus office schedules.
Notes are append-only.
Documents remain M13-owned.
Every material change writes immutable history.
Import is rooted in one explicit tenant.
Every CSV row produces a result.
Potential matches are never auto-merged.
Blocking conditions use the M00 exception model.
Tasks remain M00-owned.
Scope is derived, versioned and time-bounded.
Only one selected organization context is current.
Originating and responsible organizations are preserved.
Decision evidence is reproducible by version.
Downstream reads use versioned summaries.
Downstream reads preserve effective history.
Carrier and vendor requests are resolved by JET.
Only one ownership change may be executing.
Ending requires an individual continuity plan.
Each required consumer has a tracked state.
Exports are authorized and expiring.
Root defaults are applied after preview and confirmation.
Every override retains before and after.

Requirement_Register.title: Canonical ownership
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 is the only canonical owner of Tenant, Organization, Tenant ownership, Organization-to-Tenant assignment, effective-dated OrganizationRelationship, hierarchy history and organization provenance. M00 enforces authorization; M04 owns MarketplaceContext; M06 owns agency and workforce operational profiles; M08 owns licenses, appointments and sellability; M09 owns people and CRM; M13 owns document storage. Downstream modules must reference M05 identifiers rather than create competing organization identities.

Requirement_Register.title: Tenant operating model
Requirement_Register.statement: Lucie supports one JET internal tenant and one customer tenant per onboarded agency group or approved commercial customer. Multiple organizations, including one tenant-owning root agency and direct downlines, may exist inside a tenant. Each organization belongs to exactly one tenant. Nested tenants, cross-tenant agency hierarchies, a tenant per downline and ordinary cross-tenant user movement are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Initial tenant provisioning
Requirement_Register.statement: A JET Platform Administrator creates a customer tenant and its owning organization through one guided provisioning operation. The flow creates draft records, history and M00 context references, and starts a readiness checklist. It does not create a marketplace or activate production activity.

Requirement_Register.title: Tenant record
Requirement_Register.statement: Tenant records contain immutable tenant ID and reference code, display name, owning organization, lifecycle, effective dates, boundary classification, M00 commercial and privacy references, optional M04 default marketplace reference, version, provenance and JET-only notes. Pricing, invoices, provider credentials, marketplace branding, product rules and role definitions are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Tenant lifecycle
Requirement_Register.statement: Tenant lifecycle is fixed to DRAFT, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED and ENDED. Draft supports setup only; Active remains subject to M00 activation and launch controls; Suspended blocks normal new activity while preserving records and JET operations; Ended represents controlled offboarding and cannot be routinely reactivated.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization lifecycle
Requirement_Register.statement: Organization lifecycle is fixed to DRAFT, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED and ENDED. Workflow statuses such as invitation or review do not become canonical lifecycle states. No organization is physically deleted through the application.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization types
Requirement_Register.statement: Organization types are fixed to JET_PLATFORM, AGENCY, EMPLOYER, CARRIER, VENDOR and PARTNER. Root, parent and downline agencies all remain AGENCY; hierarchy is expressed through relationships. Custom types, MASTER_AGENCY and DOWNLINE_AGENCY types are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization record scope
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 owns a lean organization identity: immutable ID, tenant-scoped reference code, type, legal and display names, optional DBA, lifecycle, contact channels, website, addresses, time zone, default language, approved external identifiers, effective dates, version and provenance. Agency roster, affiliations, licenses, appointments, branding, employer quoting, CRM and enrollment data remain downstream.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization identity versus domain profiles
Requirement_Register.statement: Every domain-specific organization profile references exactly one M05 organization_id. Ending a downstream profile does not delete or automatically end the M05 Organization because historical and cross-domain references must remain intact.

Requirement_Register.title: External organization identifiers
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 may retain verified external organization identifiers such as EIN, agency NPN, NAIC carrier code and controlled customer or vendor references. They are masked or encrypted when sensitive, never serve as canonical keys, retain source and verification history, and do not determine licensing or sellability.

Requirement_Register.title: Cross-tenant representation of the same legal entity
Requirement_Register.statement: The same legal entity appearing in different customer tenants is represented by separate tenant-scoped organizations. A restricted registry match may indicate likely common legal identity but cannot merge tenant data, users, documents, transactions or authority.

Requirement_Register.title: Duplicate detection
Requirement_Register.statement: Organization creation performs possible-duplicate detection using names, reference codes, identifiers, domains, addresses, telephone and type. A possible match creates a warning and review task; Lucie never automatically merges organization records.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization creation authority
Requirement_Register.statement: Authorized root Agency Administrators may create, configure, activate, suspend, reactivate and end direct downline agencies inside their tenant. JET approval is not required for routine downline creation, but tenant scope, hierarchy, duplicate, profile, administrator, readiness and JET-block validations are mandatory. JET retains override and emergency authority.

Requirement_Register.title: Legal versus operating changes
Requirement_Register.statement: Downline and root administrators may update low-risk operating fields. Legal identity, tax and verified identifiers, tenant assignment, ownership, parent relationship and lifecycle changes require governed operations, reasons, effective dates, version history and downstream impact treatment. Historical evidence is never rewritten.

Requirement_Register.title: Tenant and organization status interaction
Requirement_Register.statement: Tenant and organization statuses remain separate. Tenant suspension makes all contained organizations operationally unavailable without rewriting each status. Suspending one organization does not automatically suspend siblings or children. Ending a root is blocked until direct-downline continuity is addressed.

Requirement_Register.title: Tenant ownership change
Requirement_Register.statement: Every tenant has exactly one owning organization at an effective time. Ownership change is JET-controlled and requires commercial, security, marketplace, membership, provider, open-work, downstream and prior-module impact review. It does not silently move records or users.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization movement between tenants
Requirement_Register.statement: An organization tenant_id is immutable in normal operation. A downline becoming an independent customer requires a new tenant, new or migrated organization representation, explicit user and data migration, preserved history and no temporary cross-tenant access.

Requirement_Register.title: Mergers, replacements and accidental records
Requirement_Register.statement: Lucie does not provide a general organization merge engine. Rename versions the same organization; a new legal entity creates a successor organization; accidental drafts are ended with reason; identifiers are never reused; historical transactions retain the organization/version used at the time.

Requirement_Register.title: Address and location posture
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 supports one headquarters address, one mailing address defaulting to headquarters, optional office locations, fixed location types, United States geography through M00 reference data and effective-dated history. International address support, map territories, branch contracts and location-based permission hierarchies are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Prior-module continuity
Requirement_Register.statement: Every M05 decision is evaluated against M00 and protected M01. The packet includes upstream contract consumption, prior-delivered-module impact registers, proposed append-only deltas, compatibility, migration, rollback, release notes and cumulative regression for CTX-003 Tenant, CTX-004 Organization and CTX-005 OrganizationRelationship.

Requirement_Register.title: Relationship purpose
Requirement_Register.statement: Lucie stores one directed PARENT_OF relationship whose inverse is displayed as DOWNLINE_OF. It establishes operating hierarchy, administration scope, assignment context, reporting and history only; it does not establish legal ownership, contract sharing, commissions, revenue sharing, licensing or product authority.

Requirement_Register.title: Eligible organizations
Requirement_Register.statement: PARENT_OF may connect only two AGENCY organizations in the same tenant. JET_PLATFORM, EMPLOYER, CARRIER, VENDOR and PARTNER do not participate in the Lucie agency hierarchy.

Requirement_Register.title: Lean hierarchy depth
Requirement_Register.statement: Lucie supports one direct-downline level. The tenant-owning agency is the root and all operational downlines are direct children. Downlines cannot create children; regional, branch and arbitrary graph layers are excluded. Stable identifiers and effective dates preserve a future seam.

Requirement_Register.title: Root agency rule
Requirement_Register.statement: The tenant-owning AGENCY is the single root, has no parent and may have many direct downlines. Every other active AGENCY in that tenant must have one active relationship to the root unless it is explicitly draft, ended or reference-only.

Requirement_Register.title: One active parent
Requirement_Register.statement: A downline has exactly one active parent. Multiple or overlapping parents, self-relationships, cycles and duplicate active relationships are prohibited through database and service validation.

Requirement_Register.title: Relationship lifecycle
Requirement_Register.statement: Relationship lifecycle is fixed to PENDING, ACTIVE and ENDED. Future-dated approved relationships remain Pending; Active grants approved hierarchy scope; Ended preserves history and grants no current authority. Temporary restrictions use status or authorization controls rather than a custom relationship state.

Requirement_Register.title: Relationship creation authority
Requirement_Register.statement: Authorized root Agency Administrators may create and activate direct-downline relationships after fixed validations pass; routine JET approval is not required. JET may block, suspend, correct, end or restore a relationship for security, legal, contractual, support or platform reasons.

Requirement_Register.title: Creating and configuring a downline
Requirement_Register.statement: The root receives a guided Create Downline Agency flow covering identity, legal identifiers, contacts, addresses, settings, initial administrator, inherited tenant controls, relationship, readiness and activation. Draft save and resume is supported. JET is not responsible for routine execution.

Requirement_Register.title: Relationship effective dates
Requirement_Register.statement: Every relationship retains effective_from, optional effective_to, activation and end dates and reasons, creator/approver provenance, version and immutable history. Corrections after the relationship governed activity require a separate correction record.

Requirement_Register.title: Root agency administration authority
Requirement_Register.statement: Authorized root Agency Administrators have complete administration authority over direct downlines: profile, contacts, settings, users, fixed roles, readiness, tasks, records, communications, documents, application and handoff status, activity and reporting. JET retains broader override. Secrets, JET-only notes and regulated authority remain protected.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline administrator authority
Requirement_Register.statement: A downline Agency Administrator manages its own organization and records but cannot access the root's private records, sibling downlines, create another downline, change or remove its parent, move tenants or override root or JET restrictions.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline record visibility
Requirement_Register.statement: An active parent relationship grants authorized root Agency Administrators full visibility into the direct downline's business records and settings, subject to masking, module controls, legal restrictions and audit. Ordinary root agents and staff do not inherit that full scope, and administrative visibility does not grant regulated selling authority.

Requirement_Register.title: Root agency operational reporting
Requirement_Register.statement: The root may see aggregate and record-level operational information for direct downlines. M24 later supplies richer historical analytics, but originating workspaces must honor root administrative visibility without exposing secrets or unrestricted sensitive values.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization Structure experience
Requirement_Register.statement: Organization Structure is a fixed root-and-direct-children experience with create, open, edit, manage users, view records, readiness, suspend, reactivate, end relationship and history actions. JET sees the same plus platform overrides. Drag-and-drop, arbitrary graphs and multi-level expansion are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Reassigning a downline
Requirement_Register.statement: Downline reassignment is rare and JET-controlled, used only after tenant-owner change or correction. Current and proposed parent, effective date, commercial, security, membership, marketplace, provider and open-work review and non-overlap are mandatory.

Requirement_Register.title: Ending a relationship
Requirement_Register.statement: Ending a relationship requires a continuity disposition for the downline, users, open work, transactions, external activity and history. Parent-derived access stops at effective end; consumer and transaction assignments are never silently transferred.

Requirement_Register.title: Root agency suspension
Requirement_Register.statement: Suspending the root immediately removes parent-derived authority but does not rewrite child organization states. A direct downline may continue only if tenant, organization, direct memberships, commercial controls and an approved operational support path permit it.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline suspension
Requirement_Register.statement: Suspending a downline blocks new normal activity for that organization. The root retains approved status, history and transition visibility but cannot transact as the downline merely because it is the parent.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace and provider behavior
Requirement_Register.statement: The hierarchy does not create separate marketplaces or provider routes. One tenant marketplace and M00 provider configuration remain authoritative; a downline may have attribution and communication identity settings but no independent storefront or provider credentials in Lucie MVP.

Requirement_Register.title: Workforce affiliation boundary
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 hierarchy does not create workforce affiliation, employment, writing agency, captive status, commission ownership or licensing authority. M06 and M08 remain authoritative; relationship changes require explicit downstream affiliation impact handling.

Requirement_Register.title: Commercial and financial boundary
Requirement_Register.statement: PARENT_OF is an operational hierarchy only and does not represent legal ownership, contract sharing, selling paper, commissions, payments, sponsorship, book ownership, product access or carrier appointment hierarchy. Those remain downstream seams.

Requirement_Register.title: Relationship notifications and audit
Requirement_Register.statement: Relationship requests, activations, scheduled starts and ends, corrections and ends notify relevant administrators in their selected language and produce immutable audit events with actor, context, before/after, reason, effective date and correlation ID.

Requirement_Register.title: Future compatibility
Requirement_Register.statement: The relationship contract preserves stable ID, parent and child IDs, type, status, version, effective dates, provenance and an extensible metadata boundary. Future depth or relationship types require a governed future packet and are not exposed now.

Requirement_Register.title: M00 and M01 continuity
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 proposes M00 and protected M01 deltas for hierarchy-derived context, authorization, visibility, attribution, assignment, JET EDE context, notifications, audit and regression. Existing baselines remain unchanged until approval.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization profile experience
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 provides one fixed Organization Profile with Overview, Legal identity, Contacts, Addresses and offices, External identifiers, Organization settings, Relationships, Readiness and Activity/history. Sections vary only by type and authority; custom sections, fields and configurable layouts are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Root and downline profile authority
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may view and edit the complete profile of every direct downline; downline administrators edit their own permitted data. Root overrides downline values and JET overrides both. Every edit preserves actual actor, context, old and new values, time and required reason.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline-owned settings
Requirement_Register.statement: Downline-owned settings include display and DBA names, contacts, telephone, email, website, addresses, offices, time zone, language, hours, consumer support information, assignment defaults, communication preferences, readiness and later downstream operational profile settings. Root administrators may edit or override them.

Requirement_Register.title: Setting defaults and inheritance
Requirement_Register.statement: Root or tenant defaults are copied into a new downline's initial profile. Later changes do not silently propagate. The root may explicitly apply selected approved values to one or more downlines after reviewing current and proposed values and exclusions. Dynamic inheritance and formulas are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Legal identity changes
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may propose legal name, DBA, tax identifier, agency NPN and other approved identifier changes. Material changes require reason, effective date, evidence, new version, reverification, downstream impact review and audit; JET may reject or correct them.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization contact roles
Requirement_Register.statement: Contact roles are fixed to PRIMARY_BUSINESS, OPERATIONS, SUPPORT and COMPLIANCE. Each may reference name, title, email, phone, language and optional M00 user. M05 stores contact points, not a competing M09 person record; custom roles are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Contact visibility
Requirement_Register.statement: Root and authorized downline administrators see organization contacts within scope. Ordinary workforce users and consumers see only approved purpose-specific contact information. Internal direct details, notes and compliance contacts are not automatically exposed.

Requirement_Register.title: Address model
Requirement_Register.statement: Organizations may have one HEADQUARTERS, one MAILING and multiple OFFICE addresses. Mailing defaults to headquarters. Addresses are United States only, validated against M00 geography and effective-dated. International and custom location types are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Office locations
Requirement_Register.statement: An office location contains name, type, address, main telephone, optional support email, time zone, business hours and active status. It does not create a tenant, organization, workspace, contract or permission boundary.

Requirement_Register.title: Business hours
Requirement_Register.statement: Organizations and offices support one simple weekly business-hours schedule with daily open and close times, closed days and organization time zone. Holiday calendars, split shifts, seasonal schedules, capacity calculations and routing rules are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization language
Requirement_Register.statement: Organization default language is English or Spanish, with English default. Individual M00 user preference takes precedence. Language changes apply prospectively and do not rewrite prior documents, communications, consent or audit evidence.

Requirement_Register.title: External identifier types
Requirement_Register.statement: Identifier types are fixed to EIN, AGENCY_NPN, NAIC_CARRIER_CODE, JET_CUSTOMER_CODE, VENDOR_REFERENCE, PARTNER_REFERENCE and EXTERNAL_ORGANIZATION_CODE. Records retain masked value, source, verification, dates, version and evidence. Custom types are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Identifier verification states
Requirement_Register.statement: Identifier verification states are UNVERIFIED, PENDING_VERIFICATION, VERIFIED and REJECTED. Root may enter or update; an approved service or JET verifies. Rejected values remain in history and cannot be used as valid downstream evidence.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization readiness
Requirement_Register.statement: Agency readiness uses a fixed checklist for legal and reference identity, contacts, headquarters, time zone, language, verified identifier, active parent if downline, active administrator, required downstream profile and no blocking exception. Readiness is separate from lifecycle and cannot be manually passed without resolving the control.

Requirement_Register.title: Reference employers and partners
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may create tenant-scoped EMPLOYER and PARTNER reference organizations. These records grant no access, workspace, commercial activation, contract or marketplace until a downstream module adds the appropriate profile.

Requirement_Register.title: Carrier and vendor references
Requirement_Register.statement: Carrier and shared vendor reference organizations remain JET-controlled. Root agencies submit a request when no valid reference exists and may maintain tenant-specific aliases linked to the controlled reference. Competing carrier and vendor identities are prohibited.

Requirement_Register.title: Reference organization isolation
Requirement_Register.statement: Reference organizations remain tenant-scoped unless explicitly owned as JET platform references. Creating a reference never invites a user, creates a route, contract, product access, selling authority or transaction.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization notes
Requirement_Register.statement: Organization notes use AGENCY_VISIBLE and JET_ONLY visibility. Notes are append-only, timestamped and attributed; corrections use a new note. Custom visibility matrices are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization documents
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 associates organizations to document references and purpose or status only. M13 owns storage, scanning, classification, access, retention, secure links and downloads. M05 never creates a competing attachment store.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization search and directory
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators receive a tenant-wide organization directory with type, hierarchy, lifecycle, readiness, contact, location, identifier summary, blockers and last update. Downline administrators see their own agency and permitted references only. JET searches across explicit tenant context.

Requirement_Register.title: Profile change history
Requirement_Register.statement: Profiles expose immutable history for creation, lifecycle, legal, contact, address, identifier, setting, readiness, relationship and override changes. History identifies actual actor, context, time, old and new values and reason with sensitive-value masking.

Requirement_Register.title: M04 branding and marketplace boundary
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 supplies M04 identity, legal, display and DBA names, approved contacts, language, responsible agency, lifecycle and readiness. M04 alone owns logo, theme, marketplace name and domain, visibility, routing, attribution presentation and storefront support. Downlines receive no independent storefront.

Requirement_Register.title: Downstream profile contract
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 publishes a versioned Organization Summary including tenant and organization IDs, type, names, lifecycle, parent reference, contacts, location, language, identifier summaries, readiness, version and effective dates. Downstream caches remain subordinate to M05 and consume material-change events.

Requirement_Register.title: Prior-module continuity
Requirement_Register.statement: Profile decisions produce M00 and protected M01 impacts for context display, invitations, addresses, identifiers, agency attribution, support identity, record visibility, audit, bilingual content, marketplace and JET EDE context.

Requirement_Register.title: Relationship-derived administrative scope
Requirement_Register.statement: An active PARENT_OF relationship grants the root's authorized AGENCY_ADMIN administrative scope over direct downlines in the same tenant. M05 decides valid hierarchy scope; M00 enforces it. Downstream modules consume the shared scope and never independently implement hierarchy authorization.

Requirement_Register.title: No separate root-agency role
Requirement_Register.statement: Lucie does not create a MASTER_AGENCY_ADMIN role. Root authority results from active AGENCY_ADMIN assignment to the tenant-owning active root, active tenant, active relationship and no JET block. A downline AGENCY_ADMIN receives only its own scope.

Requirement_Register.title: Explicit downline context selection
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators explicitly enter a downline operating context from structure, directory, profile, search or reporting. They never impersonate a downline user. Context records actual user, root, selected downline, tenant, marketplace, relationship, role and policy version.

Requirement_Register.title: Persistent acting-context banner
Requirement_Register.statement: While operating in downline context, a persistent banner identifies the managed downline, root agency, tenant and return action. Every change is attributed to the actual root administrator and relationship, never to a downline user.

Requirement_Register.title: Root-agency consolidated view
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators receive consolidated authorized views across the root and direct downlines, including historical suspended or ended records where permitted. Filters are fixed to organization, status, owner, module, date and work type; custom dashboards and arbitrary query builders are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Full downline record visibility
Requirement_Register.statement: Authorized root administrators may view all direct-downline business records across affected Lucie modules, subject to masking, legal hold, security and module restrictions. Credentials, authentication factors, provider secrets, hidden security signals and JET-only notes remain excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Root administrative write authority
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may perform the same approved administrative and operational actions as a downline administrator through the owning module's governed workflow. Direct database-style editing and bypassing module validation are prohibited.

Requirement_Register.title: Final and evidentiary record protection
Requirement_Register.statement: Signed documents, accepted consent, submitted applications, completed handoffs, confirmed enrollments, final quote evidence, provider responses, audit and legal-hold records are immutable or version-controlled. Corrections use amendment, withdrawal, replacement or correction workflows.

Requirement_Register.title: Regulated-action boundary
Requirement_Register.statement: Administrative visibility does not grant regulated selling. A root user may act as seller only with active M06 affiliation, M08 ALLOWED sellability, appropriate role and permission, assignment or assistance basis and required consumer authorization.

Requirement_Register.title: Ordinary root-agency users
Requirement_Register.statement: Ordinary root-agency selling agents and unlicensed staff do not automatically gain tenant-wide downline visibility. They require assignment, affiliation, consumer-approved assistance, takeover or another module-specific access basis.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline isolation
Requirement_Register.statement: A downline administrator accesses its own profile, settings, workforce, records and permitted shared references. It cannot access root-private data, sibling organizations, sibling users, sibling reports or JET-only controls.

Requirement_Register.title: Sibling downline separation
Requirement_Register.statement: Sibling downlines are isolated. Peer-to-peer browsing or sharing is prohibited. Eligible record transfer between siblings is initiated or approved by an authorized root administrator through governed reassignment or handoff.

Requirement_Register.title: Record organization attribution
Requirement_Register.statement: Every downstream business record identifies originating organization, current responsible organization, assignee, tenant, marketplace and assignment history where applicable. Root visibility does not silently change ownership or attribution.

Requirement_Register.title: Record reassignment
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may reassign eligible open leads, assistance requests, tasks, draft quotes, draft applications and unresolved work among the root and direct downlines with reason, effective date, communication and audit. Final or externally submitted evidence uses owning-module transfer or correction processes.

Requirement_Register.title: Consumer and member disclosure
Requirement_Register.statement: Consumer and member experiences identify the currently responsible agency, approved root and downline operating relationship, support contact and assigned agent where applicable. Routine root oversight does not require repeated consent, but changed assignment, purpose, seller or destination does.

Requirement_Register.title: Sensitive information and reveal controls
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators receive default masking. Sensitive-value reveal requires explicit permission, business need, approved workflow and audit. Lists, search, exports and reporting remain masked by default.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization-wide search
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may search authorized records across the tenant with responsible organization, record type, status, assignee and date. Opening a downline result establishes explicit downline context. Downline search remains restricted.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline-specific communications identity
Requirement_Register.statement: Downlines may define approved communication identity such as display name, reply-to, support phone, signature block and verified sender profile while using the single M00-controlled tenant provider route. Root may configure and override identity; M10 owns templates and delivery.

Requirement_Register.title: Marketplace attribution
Requirement_Register.statement: M04 may display M05 responsible agency, agent, contact, downline attribution and disclosure inside the one tenant marketplace. M05 does not create a separate downline storefront, domain, catalogue or provider route.

Requirement_Register.title: Documents and secure links
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may view downline documents only when the related record is in authorized scope and M13 document controls allow access. Relationship scope never bypasses classification, masking, retention, secure-link or download controls.

Requirement_Register.title: Exports and bulk actions
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may export approved data across selected direct downlines with scope, purpose, date range, masking and audit. Bulk actions are limited to safe settings, work assignment, reminders and invitation suspension; transaction history cannot be bulk rewritten.

Requirement_Register.title: Relationship change and access revocation
Requirement_Register.statement: Relationship end or invalidation revokes new parent-derived access immediately, refreshes active scope, blocks open-screen actions, requires background-job reauthorization and preserves permitted history. Reactivation restores scope only after current policy checks pass.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization status impact
Requirement_Register.statement: Downline suspension blocks its users and new normal transactions while allowing root and JET investigation and resolution. Root suspension stops parent-derived scope. Tenant suspension blocks all normal hierarchy activity.

Requirement_Register.title: Shared downstream access contract
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 publishes a versioned Effective Administrative Scope contract containing tenant owner, direct-downline relationships, user root-admin status, effective organizations, selected operating context, relationship version, effective date and policy version. M00 remains enforcement owner.

Requirement_Register.title: Downstream ownership boundaries
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 hierarchy and visibility do not replace downstream ownership: M04 marketplace, M06 profiles and affiliations, M08 licenses and sellability, M09 people and CRM, M10 communications, M13 documents, M20 employer flows, M24 analytics and M26 applications remain authoritative.

Requirement_Register.title: M00 impact and proposed deltas
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 proposes controlled M00 deltas for root scope, context selection and banner, full downline administration, search, sibling isolation, session refresh, attribution, exports, overrides, audit, permissions and regression. M00 v1.1 remains unchanged until approval.

Requirement_Register.title: Protected M01 impact and deltas
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 extends protected M01 deltas for downline consumers, quotes, PlanAI, applications, handoffs, agency disclosure, masking, audit, reassignment, relationship termination and bilingual regression. M05 leads M1D-005 without silently changing Release 1.

Requirement_Register.title: Fixed organization administration surfaces
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 provides fixed Organization Administration Home, Directory, Structure, Profile, Create Downline, Readiness, Imports, Tasks and Exceptions, Change History and JET Operations surfaces. Available actions depend on JET, root Agency Administrator or downline Agency Administrator. Custom pages, fields and saved views are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Root Agency Administration Home
Requirement_Register.statement: Root Administration Home shows root status, downline lifecycle counts, activation blockers, invitations, identifier issues, open tasks and exceptions, recent changes and quick actions. It is an operational summary, not a configurable M24 analytics dashboard.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline Administration Home
Requirement_Register.statement: Downline Administration Home shows its own completeness, lifecycle, parent, administrators, workforce summary, readiness, issues, next actions, recent changes and root or JET overrides. Sibling browsing is prohibited.

Requirement_Register.title: Guided downline creation
Requirement_Register.statement: Create Downline is a fixed guided sequence for identity, legal identifiers, contacts, addresses and offices, settings, initial administrator, readiness and activation. Draft save and resume is supported and the root is automatically selected as parent. Configurable onboarding is excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline activation
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may activate a downline when the fixed profile, duplicate, address, contact, language and time-zone, identifier, relationship, active administrator, downstream profile, exception and tenant checks pass and no JET block exists. JET routine approval is not required.

Requirement_Register.title: Initial administrator requirement
Requirement_Register.statement: A downline cannot activate until at least one invited downline Agency Administrator has accepted and holds active M00 membership. Loss of the last active administrator creates an urgent readiness exception rather than silently ending the organization.

Requirement_Register.title: Manual CSV import
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may create direct downlines through the shared M00 all-or-nothing CSV import using one fixed M05 template. JET may do so in explicit tenant context. Downline users cannot import agencies. Custom columns, mapping, formulas, nesting and cross-tenant import are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Importable organization information
Requirement_Register.statement: The fixed import template supports approved organization identity, contacts, addresses, time zone, language, external identifiers, initial administrator and initial settings. It may create invitations but never credentials or authenticated users. Carrier and shared vendor creation is excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Import validation and commit
Requirement_Register.statement: Imports validate all rows for required fields, uniqueness, duplicates, type, geography, contact format, identifiers, administrator, hierarchy, tenant scope, lifecycle and readiness. Any blocking row prevents all commits and produces a row-level error report.

Requirement_Register.title: Imported activation behavior
Requirement_Register.statement: Imports create DRAFT organizations by default. Requested activation proceeds only if every activation requirement, including accepted administrator invitation and verification, is already satisfied. Successful file validation alone never proves production readiness.

Requirement_Register.title: Applying root defaults to downlines
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may apply selected approved defaults to chosen downlines after reviewing current and proposed values, exclusions and impact. Dynamic inheritance, formulas and automatic synchronization are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Bulk lifecycle actions
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators may bulk suspend or reactivate selected direct downlines with reason, explanation, effective date, user and open-work review, confirmation and audit. Ending is individual. JET uses M00 tenant emergency suspension for tenant-wide incidents.

Requirement_Register.title: Reference-organization operations
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators directly create tenant-scoped employer and partner references. Carrier and shared vendor requests use a fixed request process for JET linking, creation or rejection to prevent duplicates.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization task and exception types
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 uses fixed task and exception types for duplicates, profile gaps, missing administrator, invalid address, identifier status, relationship conflict, activation block, suspension and ending review, migration, open-work block, downstream profile unavailable, propagation failure and prior-module compatibility.

Requirement_Register.title: Exception ownership
Requirement_Register.statement: The root owns routine downline profile, administrator, readiness, duplicate, suspension, open-work and setting exceptions. JET owns cross-tenant, tenant ownership, platform reference, security and privacy, commercial, provider, corruption and emergency exceptions. The downline owns its own routine issues until root takes control.

Requirement_Register.title: Escalation to the root agency
Requirement_Register.statement: A downline may escalate an organization issue to the root using fixed issue type, description, section, requested action, evidence, urgency and blocking impact. Root may resolve, return or escalate to JET. Configurable escalation is excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Legal identity corrections
Requirement_Register.statement: Downline administrators request legal identity corrections; root reviews and applies with current and proposed value, effective date, reason, evidence and impact acknowledgement. JET may reject, correct or override. Historical evidence remains tied to the prior version.

Requirement_Register.title: Root and JET overrides
Requirement_Register.statement: Every root or JET override records actual actor, authority, target, before and after, reason, explanation, effective date, evidence and notification unless restricted. JET overrides root and downline; root overrides downline; neither may override immutable evidence or regulated authority.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization notifications
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 emits bilingual notifications for creation, invitations, activation, suspension and reactivation, ending, relationship end, readiness block, identifier rejection, legal identity change, root and JET override, migration and import outcomes. M10 owns final templates; M00 baseline notifications bridge until M10.

Requirement_Register.title: Activity and change review
Requirement_Register.statement: Authorized users review read-only activity history filtered by organization, actor, action, date, section, lifecycle, relationship, override, import and exception. Root sees direct downlines, downline sees itself, and JET uses explicit tenant context. Sensitive values remain masked.

Requirement_Register.title: Organization exports
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrators export approved directory, contacts, addresses, identifier summaries, relationship history, readiness, administrator coverage, tasks, exceptions and history as CSV under M00 scope, purpose, masking and audit controls. Downlines export only their own organization.

Requirement_Register.title: Readiness recalculation and stale information
Requirement_Register.statement: Readiness recalculates whenever profile, administrator, identifier, relationship, status or downstream dependency changes and may be refreshed on demand. Results show ready or blocked, blockers, warnings, evaluation time, owner and next action. Users cannot manually pass failed controls.

Requirement_Register.title: Status and change propagation
Requirement_Register.statement: Material organization and relationship changes propagate through governed events to M00 and downstream modules. UI distinguishes completed, processing, downstream pending, failed and reconciliation required. Propagation failure creates an operational exception and cannot be presented as success.

Requirement_Register.title: Downline suspension, reactivation and offboarding
Requirement_Register.statement: Suspension reviews users, leads and tasks, draft work, external transactions, communications and provider activity; reactivation requires resolved blockers and readiness; ending requires an individual offboarding checklist covering work, users, consumers, transactions, documents, handoffs, exports, retention and relationship. Ended organizations are not routinely reactivated.

Requirement_Register.title: Support and operational access
Requirement_Register.statement: Routine downline administration belongs to the root, not JET. JET provides platform, tenant-owner, cross-tenant duplicate, controlled reference, security and privacy, data correction, emergency suspension and final override support under explicit context, actual identity and audit. Impersonation is prohibited.

Requirement_Register.title: M00 and protected M01 continuity
Requirement_Register.statement: Operations decisions produce detailed M00 and protected M01 impact and delta records for creation, hierarchy permissions, lifecycle, context, imports, readiness, notifications, overrides, exports, agency attribution, JET EDE and cumulative regression.

Requirement_Register.title: Final M05 delivery scope
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 delivers production-ready canonical tenant, organization and direct-downline relationship foundations, profiles, readiness, directory and structure, explicit operating contexts, hierarchy-aware scope, imports, tasks, propagation, downstream contracts and M00 and M01 delta packages. It does not implement complete marketplace, agency and agent, licensing, document, product, communications, CRM, enrollment, commission, payment or analytics domains.

Requirement_Register.title: AMS workbook authority
Requirement_Register.statement: AMS_Agency_and_Agent_Mgmt.xlsx is REFERENCE_ONLY_NON_BASELINE. It may inform field completeness, navigation, scenarios and forward references but cannot override Lucie decisions, M00, protected M01, ownership or scope, and cannot become a requirement without a new Lucie stable ID.

Requirement_Register.title: Reference-source disposition register
Requirement_Register.statement: The packet includes a reference-source disposition register with source worksheet and area, concept, Lucie interpretation, target module, disposition, reason, related requirement, forward reference and supersession note. Allowed dispositions are ADOPTED_IN_M05, DEFERRED_TO_M06, DEFERRED_TO_OTHER_MODULE, FUTURE_SEAM_ONLY, EXCLUDED_FROM_LUCIE_MVP and DUPLICATE_OF_APPROVED_REQUIREMENT.

Requirement_Register.title: M06 forward-reference package
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 produces an M06 forward-reference package for agency operational profile, roster, agent and staff profile, affiliations, office assignment, administration designation, contacts, communication preferences, status, search, documents, history, notes, interactions and tasks. These are discovery candidates, not approved M06 scope.

Requirement_Register.title: Production contract freeze
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 freezes production contracts for CTX-003 Tenant, CTX-004 Organization, CTX-005 OrganizationRelationship, Organization Summary, Readiness Summary, Effective Administrative Scope, Context Selection, Status Decision, Attribution and material change events before downstream modules implement assumptions.

Requirement_Register.title: M00 upstream-contract consumption
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 consumes M00 identity, session and context, roles and permissions, authentication, activation, feature controls, audit, tasks, notifications, imports and exports, integration operations, privacy and masking, language, environments and release controls without duplication.

Requirement_Register.title: Proposed M00 delta set
Requirement_Register.statement: The packet proposes M00 deltas for root authority, relationship scope, downline creation and lifecycle, explicit context and banner, full downline visibility, sibling isolation, search, exports, session refresh and revocation, attribution, overrides, permissions, audit and regression.

Requirement_Register.title: M00 delta implementation posture
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 may implement its canonical contracts independently, but M00-dependent behavior is versioned, compatibility-adapted, disabled by default and not activated until the proposed M00 delta is approved and implemented.

Requirement_Register.title: Protected M01 delta set
Requirement_Register.statement: The packet extends protected M01 deltas for canonical organization IDs, downline records, quotes, assistance, attribution, reassignment, PlanAI, applications and EDE, disclosure, masking, audit, lifecycle and bilingual regression. M05 leads M1D-005.

Requirement_Register.title: Protected M01 activation rule
Requirement_Register.statement: Athina must not implement or activate an M01 proposal while status is DRAFT_FOR_GOVERNED_APPROVAL and implementation status is NOT_STARTED. Approval preserves original IDs, history, terminology, production behavior, migration, compatibility and rollback.

Requirement_Register.title: M04 marketplace handoff
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 hands M04 tenant and organization IDs, tenant owner, root and downlines, names, contacts, language, status, readiness and attribution references. M04 exclusively owns MarketplaceContext, storefront, brand assets, domains, visibility, routing and presentation.

Requirement_Register.title: M06 agency and agent handoff
Requirement_Register.statement: M06 consumes M05 organization identity and hierarchy and owns agency operational profile, roster, agent and staff business profiles, affiliations, primary agency, office assignment, operational status and onboarding. M05 supplies stable IDs, scope, addresses, contacts, identifiers and lifecycle.

Requirement_Register.title: M08 licensing handoff
Requirement_Register.statement: M08 owns licenses, appointments, credentials, NPN usage, FFM IDs, E&O, carrier authorization, captive restrictions, sellability and any approved NPN override. M05 may retain verified agency NPN as an identifier but does not authorize selling.

Requirement_Register.title: M13 document handoff
Requirement_Register.statement: M13 owns file storage, scanning, classification, access, secure links, retention, versioning and downloads. M05 stores only organization-document purpose and reference. AMS document-publishing concepts are deferred to M13 discovery.

Requirement_Register.title: Initial seed and test organization structure
Requirement_Register.statement: Nonproduction seed data includes JET tenant and organization, one synthetic customer tenant and root, three direct downlines, draft and suspended downlines, employer, partner, controlled carrier and vendor references, representative roles, English and Spanish users and duplicate, readiness, import and suspension scenarios. Production uses only approved records.

Requirement_Register.title: Data migration posture
Requirement_Register.statement: M05 does not include a general legacy migration engine. It supports M00 and M01 identifier compatibility, controlled seed creation, approved CSV import, deterministic M01 organization-reference backfill, unresolved-reference exceptions, versioned evidence and rollback and reconciliation. AMS is not migration data.

Requirement_Register.title: UAT participants
Requirement_Register.statement: Formal UAT includes JET administrator, root administrator, downline administrator, root and downline selling agents, unlicensed staff, English and Spanish users, M00 authorization and operations owner and M01 owner for affected journeys. Every permission boundary is independently tested.

Requirement_Register.title: Required UAT journeys
Requirement_Register.statement: UAT covers manual and CSV creation, save and resume, duplicate review, administrator activation, downline activation, context and banner, profile, defaults and overrides, search and visibility, sibling isolation, ordinary-agent restrictions, reassignment, final-evidence protection, suspension and reactivation, relationship end and access revocation, audit, export, bilingual, accessibility and approved M00 and M01 compatibility.

Requirement_Register.title: Security and privacy acceptance
Requirement_Register.statement: Security acceptance proves no cross-tenant or sibling access, correct root scope, downline isolation, ordinary-agent restrictions, explicit audited context, immediate revocation, status enforcement, masking and reveal audit, immutable evidence, import tenant confinement, client-context tamper denial, JET override audit and export purpose enforcement.

Requirement_Register.title: Production activation gates
Requirement_Register.statement: Production activation requires product, architecture, security and privacy, M00 contract, delta disposition, bilingual, accessibility, migration, contract validation, hierarchy security, UAT, runbook rehearsal, monitoring, support, rollback, no Critical or High defect and JET Release Owner go or no-go evidence.

Requirement_Register.title: Controlled rollout
Requirement_Register.statement: Rollout is JET internal, controlled UAT tenant, one pilot root agency and its approved direct downlines, small cohort, then tenant-by-tenant activation. Hierarchy behavior is not activated globally by deployment.

Requirement_Register.title: Operational handover
Requirement_Register.statement: Operational handover includes creation, administration, duplicates, identifiers, readiness, imports, lifecycle and offboarding, relationship correction, access troubleshooting, propagation failures, audit, overrides, M00 and M01 continuity, bilingual support, exports, incidents, rollback and reconciliation. Runbooks are executable procedures.

Requirement_Register.title: Production-build-ready packet standard
Requirement_Register.statement: The packet meets the M00 v1.1 hardened standard: controlled source hierarchy, stable requirements, UX, bilingual and accessibility, canonical models, operation-specific OpenAPI, event-specific AsyncAPI, strict schemas and fixtures, migration-grade DDL, authorization contracts, executable scenarios, security, runbooks, task packs, M00 and M01 deltas, M06 forward references, traceability, manifest, hashes, QA and certification. Starter artifacts are unacceptable.

Requirement_Register.title: Change control and discovery closure
Requirement_Register.statement: Approval closes functional discovery. Later changes require a stable change record with original decision, proposed change, reason, M00, M01 and downstream impacts, data, UX, tests, compatibility, approval and target version. The AMS reference cannot expand scope without governed change.

Requirement_Register.title: Lean modular-monolith boundary
Requirement_Register.statement: Implement M05 as a bounded context in the Lucie modular monolith with explicit domain, application and infrastructure boundaries. Split deployment units only through an approved architecture delta.

Requirement_Register.title: Canonical ownership enforcement
Requirement_Register.statement: No M05 consumer may write canonical tenant, organization or relationship state except through M05 commands. Downstream modules retain opaque references and read models only.

Requirement_Register.title: Service-side context resolution
Requirement_Register.statement: Resolve tenant, selected organization, root relationship, role assignment and policy version on the server for every protected command and query; reject client-supplied authority.

Requirement_Register.title: Transactional command processing
Requirement_Register.statement: Every state-changing operation is atomic across canonical record, history, outbox event, audit envelope and propagation status, using idempotency and optimistic concurrency where specified.

Requirement_Register.title: Read model separation
Requirement_Register.statement: Provide purpose-specific read models for directory, structure, profile, readiness and downstream summaries without exposing canonical tables directly.

Requirement_Register.title: Compatibility adapters
Requirement_Register.statement: Introduce versioned adapters for M00 and M01 consumption and preserve old contract behavior until proposed deltas are approved and activated.

Requirement_Register.title: Feature and activation isolation
Requirement_Register.statement: Deploying M05 does not activate hierarchy behavior. Capability exposure requires environment, tenant, M00 delta, M01 delta where applicable, feature and launch-gate approval.

Requirement_Register.title: No generalized engines
Requirement_Register.statement: Do not introduce generic hierarchy, workflow, policy, role, field, form, dashboard or integration builders in M05.

Requirement_Register.title: Deterministic identifiers
Requirement_Register.statement: Use immutable UUID primary identifiers and separate human-readable reference codes. IDs are never reused, derived from names or exposed as authority.

Requirement_Register.title: Environment separation
Requirement_Register.statement: Local Development, QA, UAT and Production use separate configuration, credentials, data and activation states. Production data is prohibited from ordinary nonproduction use.

Requirement_Register.title: Migration-grade schema
Requirement_Register.statement: Deliver ordered PostgreSQL migrations with primary keys, foreign keys, unique and check constraints, indexes, forced row-level security, immutable-history controls and repeatable verification.

Requirement_Register.title: Tenant row-level isolation
Requirement_Register.statement: All tenant-scoped tables contain tenant_id and enforce database policies based on validated session context in addition to application authorization.

Requirement_Register.title: One root constraint
Requirement_Register.statement: Enforce one active tenant owner and one active root agency per customer tenant, with no active parent relationship for the root.

Requirement_Register.title: One active parent constraint
Requirement_Register.statement: Enforce one active PARENT_OF relationship per child, same-tenant parent and child, no self-link and no overlapping active effective periods.

Requirement_Register.title: Direct-downline depth constraint
Requirement_Register.statement: Prevent an organization that is itself a child from becoming an active parent in Lucie MVP.

Requirement_Register.title: Effective-dated history
Requirement_Register.statement: Preserve versions and effective periods for organizations, relationships, contacts, addresses, identifiers, settings and ownership changes. Historical references remain reconstructable.

Requirement_Register.title: Immutable evidence
Requirement_Register.statement: Make audit, accepted change evidence, import results, submitted overrides and final lifecycle evidence append-only through database controls and service authorization.

Requirement_Register.title: Sensitive identifier protection
Requirement_Register.statement: Encrypt or tokenize sensitive identifier values at rest, expose masked display forms by default and keep plaintext out of logs, events, URLs, exports and analytics.

Requirement_Register.title: Outbox and propagation status
Requirement_Register.statement: Use a transactional outbox and per-consumer propagation status so user-visible state distinguishes committed, downstream pending, failed and reconciled.

Requirement_Register.title: Retention and legal hold
Requirement_Register.statement: Apply M00 retention classification and legal-hold controls to M05 records; application deletion does not remove retained history or evidence.

Requirement_Register.title: Operation-specific OpenAPI
Requirement_Register.statement: Define each logical operation in OpenAPI 3.1 with operation-specific request and response schema, explicit permissions, context requirements, error codes, examples, idempotency and concurrency behavior.

Requirement_Register.title: Error contract
Requirement_Register.statement: Return stable machine-readable error codes, user-safe English and Spanish messages, correlation ID, field violations and retry guidance without leaking internal diagnostics.

Requirement_Register.title: Optimistic concurrency
Requirement_Register.statement: Require If-Match or equivalent version preconditions for material updates and return a conflict with the current version when stale.

Requirement_Register.title: Idempotent mutations
Requirement_Register.statement: Require an idempotency key for create, activation, lifecycle, import commit, bulk action, override, reassignment and externally consequential commands.

Requirement_Register.title: Pagination and filtering
Requirement_Register.statement: List and search endpoints use bounded cursor pagination, deterministic ordering, approved filters and tenant and hierarchy authorization before querying.

Requirement_Register.title: AsyncAPI event contracts
Requirement_Register.statement: Define all material M05 events in AsyncAPI 3.0 with strict event-specific schemas, version, owner, partition key, provenance and consumer compatibility.

Requirement_Register.title: Event delivery semantics
Requirement_Register.statement: Use at-least-once event delivery with idempotent consumers, ordered processing within aggregate, dead-letter handling and reconciliation. Consumers tolerate duplicates.

Requirement_Register.title: Schema compatibility
Requirement_Register.statement: Schema changes remain backward compatible within the supported major version; breaking changes require a new version, migration and downstream approval.

Requirement_Register.title: Webhook and callback safety
Requirement_Register.statement: Where downstream acknowledgements are asynchronous, validate authenticity, match correlation, reject duplicates and preserve original command context.

Requirement_Register.title: Bulk and import contracts
Requirement_Register.statement: Bulk and import operations expose preview, validation, commit, status, results and error-report contracts and cannot commit partially when any blocking row exists.

Requirement_Register.title: Deny-by-default authorization
Requirement_Register.statement: Every operation requires an explicit M00 permission and evaluated M05 scope; absence, ambiguity, stale relationship or failed context validation denies access.

Requirement_Register.title: Root scope conditions
Requirement_Register.statement: Root administrative scope requires active tenant, root organization, root AGENCY_ADMIN role, active direct relationship, selected downline context where needed and no JET block.

Requirement_Register.title: Sibling and cross-tenant isolation
Requirement_Register.statement: Automated and database controls deny root, downline, sibling and cross-tenant combinations outside approved scope, including direct-object-reference tampering.

Requirement_Register.title: Immediate scope revocation
Requirement_Register.statement: Relationship, role, membership or organization status changes invalidate effective scope for active sessions, open screens and background jobs without requiring sign-out.

Requirement_Register.title: No impersonation
Requirement_Register.statement: JET and root users operate under their own identities and explicit contexts. Production impersonation or hidden login-as behavior is prohibited.

Requirement_Register.title: Privileged action step-up
Requirement_Register.statement: Require recent authentication or MFA step-up for tenant ownership, root and downline lifecycle, legal identity, bulk lifecycle, sensitive export, JET override and emergency actions.

Requirement_Register.title: Masking and reveal
Requirement_Register.statement: Apply M00 masking by default. Reveal requires permission, stated purpose, approved workflow, minimum necessary display, automatic remasking and audit.

Requirement_Register.title: Export controls
Requirement_Register.statement: Exports require authorized scope, selected organizations, approved purpose, masking, bounded date range, secure delivery, expiry and export-of-export audit.

Requirement_Register.title: Audit integrity
Requirement_Register.statement: Audit actual actor, acting organization, selected downline, relationship and version, permission, before and after, reason, result, correlation and timestamp. Audit records cannot be edited through application APIs.

Requirement_Register.title: Abuse and rate controls
Requirement_Register.statement: Apply rate limits and abuse detection to search, import, export, identifier verification, invitations and lifecycle commands without exposing tenant existence.

Requirement_Register.title: Automated requirement coverage
Requirement_Register.statement: Every requirement links to acceptance criteria, automated or controlled manual scenarios, implementation tasks and evidence expectations.

Requirement_Register.title: Bilingual parity testing
Requirement_Register.statement: Every activated M05 user-facing screen, validation, notification, import report, export message and unavailable state is tested in English and Spanish.

Requirement_Register.title: Accessibility acceptance
Requirement_Register.statement: All screens and documents meet WCAG 2.2 AA with keyboard, focus, screen reader, contrast, zoom, responsive layout, language metadata and non-color status evidence.

Requirement_Register.title: Hierarchy security matrix
Requirement_Register.statement: Execute positive and negative tests for JET, root admin, downline admin, root agent, downline agent, unlicensed staff, suspended entities, ended relationships, siblings and cross-tenant actors.

Requirement_Register.title: Migration verification
Requirement_Register.statement: Run every ordered migration from an empty database and supported prior baseline, verify constraints, RLS, indexes and seeds, and prove rollback or forward-fix procedures.

Requirement_Register.title: Event contract tests
Requirement_Register.statement: Validate every event schema, representative fixture, duplicate delivery, out-of-order handling where applicable, consumer idempotency and dead-letter and reconciliation path.

Requirement_Register.title: Performance baseline
Requirement_Register.statement: Establish and test bounded response and throughput targets for directory, structure, search, profile, readiness, imports, exports and propagation without weakening authorization.

Requirement_Register.title: Resilience testing
Requirement_Register.statement: Exercise transient database, queue and downstream failures; preserve committed work, surface pending and retry states and prevent duplicate or false-success outcomes.

Requirement_Register.title: Operational telemetry
Requirement_Register.statement: Emit structured logs, metrics and traces for commands, queries, scope decisions, imports, propagation, overrides, failures and runbook indicators without sensitive payloads.

Requirement_Register.title: Backup and recovery
Requirement_Register.statement: Define and test backup, point-in-time recovery, event and outbox reconciliation and evidence-preserving recovery objectives consistent with M00.

Requirement_Register.title: Runbook rehearsal
Requirement_Register.statement: Rehearse duplicate resolution, import failure, propagation failure, relationship revocation, suspension, offboarding, security incident, export incident and rollback before production activation.

Requirement_Register.title: Prior-module regression gate
Requirement_Register.statement: No M05 release passes while any identified M00 or M01 impact lacks a linked disposition, compatibility plan, regression scope and approval status.

Requirement_Register.title: Release evidence package
Requirement_Register.statement: Produce immutable build, test, security, accessibility, migration, UAT, runbook, monitoring, delta and go or no-go evidence tied to the released version.

Requirement_Register.title: AI implementation controls
Requirement_Register.statement: AI-assisted implementation cites stable IDs, consumes controlled contracts, avoids inventing scope, records assumptions and requires human review for security, privacy, legal and delta decisions.

Risk_Register.title: Cross-tenant access
Risk_Register.description: Hierarchy logic could expose another tenant.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Server context, RLS, negative tests and audit.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Sibling downline access
Risk_Register.description: A downline could access another sibling.
Risk_Register.mitigation: One-direction scope, row filters and matrix tests.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Root scope overreach
Risk_Register.description: Ordinary root users could inherit full administrative access.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Root AGENCY_ADMIN condition and explicit permissions.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Regulated authority confusion
Risk_Register.description: Administrative visibility could be mistaken for sellability.
Risk_Register.mitigation: M06 and M08 checks and explicit UI language.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Stale relationship access
Risk_Register.description: Ended relationship might remain usable in a session.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Scope versioning, immediate invalidation and job reauthorization.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Duplicate organization
Risk_Register.mitigation: Duplicate review, no auto-merge and activation block.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Import partial commit
Risk_Register.description: Mixed success could create uncertain state.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: History rewrite
Risk_Register.description: Legal or profile corrections could change prior evidence.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: M00 divergence
Risk_Register.description: M05 could silently change platform authorization.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Proposed M00 deltas and disabled-by-default activation.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: M01 divergence
Risk_Register.description: M05 could silently change protected shopping behavior.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Protected delta companion and approval gate.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Downstream contract drift
Risk_Register.description: Modules could implement their own hierarchy rules.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Versioned scope contract and consumer tests.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Provider or marketplace coupling
Risk_Register.description: Downline identity could accidentally create routes or storefronts.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Explicit M00 and M04 ownership boundary.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Sensitive identifier exposure
Risk_Register.description: EIN or NPN data could leak through logs or exports.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Encryption, masking, field allowlists and log scanning.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Root override misuse
Risk_Register.description: Root could make high-impact changes without evidence.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Step-up, reason, before and after, notification and audit.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: JET support overreach
Risk_Register.description: Support could impersonate users or browse broadly.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Explicit context, no impersonation and emergency-access controls.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Bilingual incompleteness
Risk_Register.description: Spanish users could enter incomplete English-only flows.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Parity gate and disabled capability if incomplete.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Accessibility regression
Risk_Register.description: Dense administration screens could become inaccessible.
Risk_Register.mitigation: WCAG criteria, component standards and test evidence.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations

Risk_Register.title: Operational recovery gap
Risk_Register.description: Propagation or lifecycle failure could require undocumented intervention.
Risk_Register.owner: M05 Product, Engineering, Security and Operations
