User_Flow_Register.name: Create one direct downline
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root creates, configures, invites administrator, reviews readiness and activates a direct downline.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Create downlines by CSV
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root downloads template, uploads, validates all rows, resolves errors, commits and reviews results.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Enter and exit downline context
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root selects a direct downline, sees persistent context and returns to root without impersonation.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Edit and override a downline setting
User_Flow_Register.summary: Downline edits its permitted value; root reviews and overrides with evidence.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Apply root defaults
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root selects settings and downlines, previews impacts, confirms and reviews results.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Review possible duplicate
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root or JET compares a proposed organization with matches and resolves without automatic merge.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Verify an external identifier
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root submits identifier and evidence; verification result updates readiness.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Search across downlines
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root searches authorized records and opens a result in explicit downline context.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Reassign eligible open work
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root moves eligible open work among root and direct downlines while preserving history and notifying users.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Suspend and reactivate a downline
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root reviews impact, suspends, resolves blockers and reactivates.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: End a relationship and offboard
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root or JET completes individual continuity checklist and ends relationship and access safely.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Request carrier or vendor reference
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root requests a controlled reference; JET links, creates or rejects.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Resolve propagation failure
User_Flow_Register.summary: JET inspects correlation, retries or reconciles without false success.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Perform authorized export
User_Flow_Register.summary: Root selects organizations, purpose and field set; export applies masking and expires.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Change tenant owner
User_Flow_Register.summary: JET completes impact review, schedules and executes ownership change without silent data movement.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

User_Flow_Register.name: Review prior-module delta
User_Flow_Register.summary: Owner reviews M00 or M01 impact, approves or rejects proposal and preserves baseline.
User_Flow_Register.accessibility: All steps meet WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve focus and status announcements.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Tenant Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: tenant_id is required and matches server-resolved context.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Organization Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: organization_id is required for organization-scoped actions.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Reference Code Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: reference_code is required, normalized and unique inside its scope.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Legal Name Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: legal_name is required before activation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Organization Type Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: organization_type is one of the fixed Lucie values.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Tenant Status Conflict
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: tenant transition is permitted by the fixed state model.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Organization Status Conflict
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: organization transition is permitted by the fixed state model.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Ended Terminal
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: an ended tenant or organization cannot be routinely reactivated.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Root Owner Mismatch
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: tenant-owning organization is the effective root for customer agency tenants.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Root Has Parent
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: the root agency cannot have an active parent.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Child Not Agency
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: a child in PARENT_OF is an AGENCY.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Parent Not Agency
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: a parent in PARENT_OF is an AGENCY.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Relationship Cross Tenant
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: parent and child belong to the same tenant.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Relationship Self
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: an organization cannot be its own parent.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Relationship Cycle
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: relationship creation cannot create a cycle.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Relationship Depth
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: a current downline cannot become an active parent in Lucie MVP.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Multiple Active Parent
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: a child cannot have more than one active parent.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Relationship Overlap
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: relationship effective periods for a child cannot overlap.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Relationship Effective Range
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: effective_to is later than effective_from.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Relationship Not Active
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: relationship-derived scope requires an active relationship.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Root Admin Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: root action requires active AGENCY_ADMIN membership at the root.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Downline Context Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: downline-scoped root action requires explicit selected context.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Sibling Access Denied
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: a downline actor cannot target a sibling.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Cross Tenant Access Denied
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: no actor or record scope may cross tenants.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Regulated Authority Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: regulated action requires owning-module affiliation and sellability.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Primary Contact Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: primary business contact is required for activation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Support Contact Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: support contact is required for activation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Headquarters Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: one active headquarters address is required.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Headquarters Unique
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: only one active headquarters address is permitted.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Mailing Unique
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: only one active mailing address is permitted.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Us Address Only
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: addresses use supported United States geography.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Time Zone Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: organization time zone is required for activation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Language Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: default language is EN or ES.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Contact Role Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: contact role is one of the fixed roles.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Identifier Type Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: identifier type is one of the fixed types.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Identifier Duplicate
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: an effective identifier conflict is reviewed.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Identifier Mask Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: sensitive identifier responses use masked display.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Identifier Verification Conflict
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: verification transition preserves history and evidence.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Readiness Not Ready
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: activation is blocked when readiness is not acceptable.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Active Admin Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: activation requires an accepted active downline administrator.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Duplicate Review Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: unresolved possible duplicate blocks activation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Setting Key Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: only approved setting keys may be changed.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Override Reason Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: root or JET override requires reason and explanation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Immutable Evidence
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: final evidentiary state cannot be updated in place.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Import Template Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: uploaded CSV matches the governed template.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Import Row Blocking
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: any blocking row prevents all commits.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Import Tenant Mismatch
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: imported records cannot target another tenant.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Import Nested Parent
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: import parent is always the selected root.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Import User Credential Prohibited
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: imports cannot create credentials or passwords.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Export Purpose Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: export requires an approved purpose.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Export Scope Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: export organizations are inside effective scope.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Export Field Invalid
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: export contains only approved fields.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Context Stale
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: stale relationship, role, membership or policy invalidates context.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Version Conflict
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: material update requires current version.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Idempotency Required
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: governed mutation requires idempotency key.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Propagation Pending
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: downstream pending is not displayed as completed.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Reference Jet Controlled
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: carrier and shared vendor creation requires JET.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Ending Open Blockers
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: ending cannot complete while mandatory blockers remain.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Ownership Impact Incomplete
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: owner change cannot approve without impact review.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Delta Not Approved
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: M00 or M01 delta behavior cannot activate before approval.
